about: Investedia company directory. A company is the business; listings are its tradable stocks. Built from markets.json; facts beyond name, country, sector and listings come only from tools/companies-extra.json with sources.

companies.name: 3I
companies.description: 3i Group plc is a British multinational private equity and infrastructure investment company based in London, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index. The company focuses on private equity and infrastructure investments.

companies.name: 3M
companies.description: The 3M Company is an American multinational conglomerate based in Maplewood, Minnesota. It operates in industry, worker safety, and consumer goods, producing over 60,000 products including adhesives, abrasives, and personal protective equipment. Some well-known brands include Scotch Tape and Post-it notes.

companies.name: Abb
companies.description: ABB Group is a Swedish-Swiss technology company operating in electrification and automation. It was formed in 1988 from the merger of ASEA of Sweden and Brown, Boveri & Cie of Switzerland. The company focuses on technology solutions in these fields.

companies.name: ABB
companies.description: ABB Group is a Swedish-Swiss technology company operating in electrification and automation. It was formed in 1988 from the merger of ASEA of Sweden and Brown, Boveri & Cie of Switzerland. The company focuses on technology solutions in these fields.

companies.name: Abbott Laboratories
companies.description: Abbott Laboratories is an American multinational medical devices and health care company founded in Chicago with headquarters in Abbott Park, Illinois. It produces pharmaceuticals for sale outside the United States, diagnostic products, nutritional products, and medical devices.

companies.name: AbbVie
companies.description: AbbVie Inc. is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in North Chicago, Illinois. The company produces drugs to treat a wide range of medical issues. It operates primarily in the pharmaceutical industry.

companies.name: Absa
companies.description: Absa Group Limited is a multinational banking and financial services conglomerate based in Johannesburg, South Africa. It offers personal and business banking, credit cards, corporate and investment banking, wealth and investment management, and bank assurances. The company is listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Ackermans V.Haaren
companies.description: Ackermans & van Haaren is a diversified Belgian group active in marine engineering and contracting, private banking, real estate, energy and resources, and growth capital. The company operates across multiple sectors as a holding company.

companies.name: Acs,Actividades De Construccion
companies.description: ACS, Actividades de Construcción y Servicios, S.A. is a Spanish company dedicated to civil engineering, construction, services, and telecommunications. Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Madrid, it is one of the leading construction companies globally with projects in many countries. It is listed on the Bolsa de Madrid and part of the IBEX 35 index.

companies.name: ACWA POWER
companies.description: ACWA Power is a Saudi Arabian company that develops, invests in, co-owns, and operates power generation and desalinated water production plants. It has a presence in 14 countries across the Middle East, Africa, and Central and Southeast Asia. The company manages projects with a total capacity of 78.85 GW of power and produces 9.5 million cubic meters of desalinated water daily.

companies.name: Adani Enterprises
companies.description: Adani Enterprises Limited is an Indian multinational holding company headquartered in Ahmedabad. It primarily focuses on mining and trading coal and iron ore. The company also has subsidiaries involved in airport operations, edible oils, infrastructure, data centers, and solar manufacturing.

companies.name: adidas
companies.description: Adidas AG is a German multinational corporation headquartered in Herzogenaurach, Germany, that manufactures athletic apparel and footwear. It is the largest sportswear manufacturer in Europe and the second largest globally. Adidas owns an 8.33% stake in Bayern Munich and the fitness technology company Runtastic.

companies.name: Adobe
companies.description: Adobe Inc. is an American multinational computer software company based in San Jose, California. It offers a wide range of software programs including web design tools, photo manipulation, vector creation, video and audio editing, mobile app development, print layout, and animation software.

companies.name: Advanc_Advanced Info Service
companies.description: Advanced Info Service Co., Ltd. (AIS) is Thailand's largest GSM mobile phone operator. Founded in 1986 initially as a computer rental business, it launched analog mobile phone services in 1990 with a 20-year monopoly concession. AIS was the first company allowed to operate on the GSM-900 frequency in Thailand.

companies.name: Adyen
companies.description: Adyen is a Dutch payment company that operates as an acquiring bank, enabling businesses to accept e-commerce, mobile, and point-of-sale payments. It is publicly listed on Euronext Amsterdam.

companies.name: Aflac
companies.description: Aflac Incorporated is an American insurance company based in Columbus, Georgia. Founded in 1955, it is the largest provider of supplemental insurance in the United States. The company offers payroll deduction insurance coverage that pays cash benefits for covered accidents or illnesses.

companies.name: Ageas
companies.description: Ageas is a Belgian multinational insurance company co-headquartered in Brussels. It is Belgium's largest insurer and operates in 13 countries worldwide. The company was renamed from Fortis Holding in 2010 after the breakup of the Fortis financial services group.

companies.name: Aia
companies.description: AIA Group Limited is a Hong Kong-based multinational insurance and finance company. It is one of the largest publicly traded life insurance groups in the Asia-Pacific region. The company originated from an American insurance firm established in Shanghai in 1919 and was formerly part of AIG before separating after the 2008 financial crisis.

companies.name: Air Liquide
companies.description: Air Liquide S.A. is a French multinational company supplying industrial gases and services to industries such as medical, chemical, and electronics. Founded in 1902, it is the second largest global supplier of industrial gases by revenue and operates in over 70 countries.

companies.name: Airbus
companies.description: Airbus SE is a European aerospace corporation primarily engaged in designing and manufacturing commercial aircraft. It also operates divisions for Defence and Space and Helicopters, and is recognized as the world's leading helicopter manufacturer and largest airliner manufacturer as of 2019.

companies.name: Airports of Thailand
companies.description: The Airports of Thailand Public Company Limited manages ten international airports in Thailand. It is a public company responsible for airport operations within the country.

companies.name: Akbank
companies.description: Akbank T.A.Ş. is a prominent Turkish bank founded in 1948. It offers services in corporate and investment banking, commercial banking, SME banking, consumer banking, payment systems, private banking, investment services, and treasury transactions. The Sabancı family are its largest shareholders.

companies.name: Aker Bp
companies.description: Aker BP ASA is a Norwegian oil exploration and development company focused on petroleum resources on the Norwegian Continental Shelf. Headquartered in Fornebu, it has additional offices in Trondheim, Stavanger, and Harstad, employing over 2,400 staff.

companies.name: Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk
companies.description: PT AlamTri Resources Tbk is an Indonesian coal mining company and the country's second-largest by production volume. It operates the largest single-site coal mine in the southern hemisphere located in Tabalong district, South Kalimantan, and is ranked among the largest public companies globally.

companies.name: Alcon
companies.description: Alcon Inc. is a Swiss-American pharmaceutical and medical device company specializing in eye care products. Incorporated in Fribourg, Switzerland, its global headquarters are in Geneva, with main operations in Fort Worth, Texas, employing about 4,500 people.

companies.name: Alibaba
companies.description: Alibaba Group Holding Limited is a Chinese multinational technology company specializing in e-commerce, retail, internet, and technology. Founded in 1999 in Hangzhou, it provides C2C, B2C, and B2B sales services through various marketplaces and operates diverse businesses globally.

companies.name: Alimentation Couche-Tard
companies.description: Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc. is a Canadian multinational convenience store operator with approximately 16,700 stores across multiple countries. It operates stores under brands including Couche-Tard, Circle K, On the Run, and several affiliated brands.

companies.name: Alinma Bank
companies.description: Alinma Bank is a Saudi joint stock company established in 2006 by Royal Decree. It operates as a bank in Saudi Arabia and has more than 2,658 employees. The name Alinma translates to "growth" or "development" in Arabic.

companies.name: Allegro.Eu
companies.description: Allegro is a Polish online marketplace and e-commerce platform headquartered in Poznań. It operates marketplaces in Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, and Hungary. The parent company, Allegro.eu S.A., is incorporated in Luxembourg and listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Allianz
companies.description: Allianz SE is a German multinational financial services company headquartered in Munich. Its core businesses are insurance and asset management. Allianz operates globally in the financial services sector.

companies.name: Allstate
companies.description: The Allstate Corporation is an American insurance company headquartered in Glenview, Illinois since 2022. Founded in 1931 as part of Sears, it became fully independent in 1995. The company also operates personal line insurance in Canada.

companies.name: Almarai
companies.description: Almarai Company is a Saudi multinational dairy company listed on the Tadawul stock exchange. It operates in the food industry and is based in Saudi Arabia. Almarai is known for its dairy products.

companies.name: Alpha Bank
companies.description: Alpha Bank is a Greek bank headquartered in Athens, founded in 1918 by John Kostopoulos. It has been listed on the Athens Stock Exchange since 1925 and operates branches in Greece and Cyprus. The bank employs approximately 8,500 people.

companies.name: Alphabet
companies.description: Alphabet is the holding company of Google. Most of its revenue comes from advertising on Google Search and YouTube. It also sells cloud computing through Google Cloud, subscriptions, apps and devices, and funds longer-term businesses such as Waymo.

story.title: Google is founded
story.text: Larry Page and Sergey Brin incorporate Google in California.

story.text: Google completes its purchase of YouTube.

story.title: Alphabet is created
story.text: Google reorganises under a new parent company, Alphabet Inc.

companies.name: Amadeus It
companies.description: Amadeus IT Group, S.A. is a Spanish multinational technology company providing software for the global travel and tourism industry. The parent company holds over 99.7% of the firm. It was listed on Spanish stock exchanges in 2010.

companies.name: Amazon.com
companies.description: Amazon.com, Inc. is an American multinational conglomerate engaged in e-commerce, retail, cloud computing, and other sectors. Founded in 1994 by Jeff Bezos in Bellevue, Washington, it started as an online book marketplace and expanded to many product categories.

companies.name: Ambev
companies.description: Ambev S.A. is a Brazilian brewing and bottling company owned by Anheuser-Busch InBev. Created in 1999 from the merger of Brahma and Antarctica, it is headquartered in São Paulo. Ambev is the largest beer manufacturer in the world and controls about 69% of the Brazilian beer market.

companies.name: América Movil
companies.description: América Móvil is a Mexican telecommunications corporation headquartered in Mexico City. It is the seventh largest mobile network operator worldwide by equity subscribers and one of the largest corporations globally. The company had over 310 million wireless subscribers as of December 2023.

companies.name: American Electric Power
companies.description: American Electric Power Company, Inc. is a major electric utility company based in the United States. It serves more than five million customers across 11 states. The company is one of the largest electric utilities in the country.

companies.name: American International
companies.description: American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global insurance company headquartered in New York City. Founded in 1919, it operates in over 200 countries and offers a range of insurance products including commercial, personal, property, casualty, and specialty insurance. AIG also provides risk management and multinational insurance services.

companies.name: American Tower
companies.description: American Tower Corporation is a real estate investment trust based in Boston, Massachusetts. It owns, develops, and operates wireless and broadcast communications infrastructure in multiple countries. The company focuses on communications infrastructure assets.

companies.name: Analog Devices
companies.description: Analog Devices, Inc. is an American multinational semiconductor company headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts. It specializes in data conversion, signal processing, and power management technologies. The company is also known simply as Analog.

companies.name: Andritz
companies.description: Andritz AG is an international technology group headquartered in Graz, Austria. It provides plants, equipment, systems, and services for various industries. The company is named after the district of Andritz and is listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Anglo American
companies.description: Anglo American plc is a British multinational mining company headquartered in London, England. It is the world's largest producer of platinum, accounting for about 40% of global output, and also produces diamonds, copper, nickel, iron ore, polyhalite, and steelmaking coal. The company operates across multiple continents including Africa, Asia, Australia, Europe, and the Americas.

companies.name: AngloGold Ashanti
companies.description: AngloGold Ashanti Limited is a South African gold mining company with global operations. It was formed in 2004 through the merger of AngloGold and Ashanti Goldfields Corporation. The company has a diverse portfolio of operations, projects, and exploration activities worldwide.

companies.name: ANZ
companies.description: ANZ Bank, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, is a multinational banking and financial services company. It is Australia's second-largest bank by assets and fourth-largest by market capitalization. The bank operates primarily in Australia and New Zealand.

companies.name: Apple
companies.description: Apple Inc. is an American multinational technology company based in Cupertino, California. Founded in 1976, it is known for consumer electronics, software, and online services. The company changed its name in 2007 to reflect its expansion beyond computers.

companies.name: Applied Materials
companies.description: Applied Materials, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It supplies equipment, services, and software for manufacturing semiconductor chips, flat panel displays, and solar products. It is the second largest supplier of semiconductor equipment worldwide by revenue.

companies.name: Arm
companies.description: Arm Holdings plc is a British semiconductor and software design company headquartered in Cambridge. It designs CPU cores implementing the ARM architecture and provides software development tools and system-on-chip infrastructure. Since 2016, it has been majority owned by SoftBank Group.

companies.name: Ase Technology
companies.description: Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc., formerly ASE Group, is a semiconductor packaging and test manufacturing services provider headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. It operates independently in the semiconductor industry.

companies.name: Aselsan
companies.description: Aselsan A.Ş. is a Turkish defense corporation based in Ankara. It focuses on research, development, and manufacturing of advanced military products for air, land, and maritime forces. The company is a major contractor for the Turkish Armed Forces and was ranked 48th largest defense company by revenue.

companies.name: Asian Paints
companies.description: Asian Paints is an Indian multinational company headquartered in Mumbai. It manufactures, sells, and distributes paints, coatings, home décor products, and bath fittings. It is the largest paint company in India by market share.

companies.name: ASM International
companies.description: ASM International N.V. is a Dutch multinational corporation that designs, manufactures, sells, and services equipment used in semiconductor device fabrication. Its products support processes like atomic layer deposition and chemical vapor deposition in semiconductor fabrication plants.

companies.name: ASML
companies.description: ASML Holding N.V. is a Dutch multinational technology company that develops and manufactures photolithography machines for integrated circuit production. It is the largest supplier to the semiconductor industry and the only manufacturer of extreme ultraviolet lithography machines as of 2026.

companies.name: ASSA ABLOY
companies.description: Assa Abloy AB is a Swedish company specializing in products and services related to locks, doors, gates, and entrance automation. It also provides access control and identity verification systems using keys, cards, tags, mobile, and biometric technologies.

companies.name: Astra International
companies.description: PT Astra International Tbk, commonly known as Astra, is an Indonesian conglomerate headquartered in Jakarta. It is one of the largest publicly listed companies on the Indonesia Stock Exchange and is majority-owned by Jardine Cycle & Carriage, a subsidiary of Jardine Matheson.

companies.name: AstraZeneca
companies.description: AstraZeneca plc is a Swedish–British multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company headquartered at the Cambridge Biomedical Campus in Cambridge, England. It has a portfolio of products targeting major diseases in areas such as oncology, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, infection, neuroscience, respiratory, and inflammation.

companies.name: Atlas Copco
companies.description: Atlas Copco Group is a Swedish multinational industrial company that manufactures compressors, vacuum equipment, pumps, generators, assembly tools, and quality assurance equipment. Its products serve industrial applications and mobile power generation and are sold in around 180 countries.

companies.name: Auckland International Airport
companies.description: Auckland Airport is the largest and busiest international airport in New Zealand, serving Auckland. It is operated by Auckland International Airport Limited and is located near Māngere and Airport Oaks suburbs. The airport serves as the principal hub for Air New Zealand and the New Zealand base for Jetstar.

companies.name: AXA
companies.description: Axa S.A. is a French multinational insurance company headquartered in Paris. It ranks among the largest insurers globally by revenue and offers assistance and related services through its subsidiaries. The group operates in 52 countries with over 92 million customers.

companies.name: Axiata
companies.description: Axiata Group Berhad is a Malaysian multinational telecommunications conglomerate with extensive operations across Asia. It is involved in the telecommunications industry.

companies.name: Axis Bank
companies.description: Axis Bank Limited is an Indian multinational banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It is the third largest private sector bank in India by assets and offers financial services to large and mid-size companies, SMEs, and retail businesses.

companies.name: Azrieli
companies.description: Azrieli Group is an Israeli real estate and holding company named after its founder David Azrieli. The company focuses mainly on the development and management of shopping malls and office buildings in Israel.

companies.name: BAE Systems
companies.description: BAE Systems plc is a British multinational company specializing in aerospace, arms, and information security. It is based in London and is the largest defence contractor in Europe and the sixth largest worldwide. The company was formed in 1999 by merging Marconi Electronic Systems with British Aerospace.

companies.name: Bajaj Finance
companies.description: Bajaj Finance Limited is an Indian non-banking financial company headquartered in Pune. It was originally formed as Bajaj Auto Finance Limited to provide financing for Bajaj's two and three wheeler segments. The company operates in the financial services sector.

companies.name: Banco De Chile
companies.description: Banco de Chile is a Chilean commercial bank headquartered in Santiago de Chile. It offers a range of financial services and operates a national network of branches and ATMs. The bank serves clients through multiple electronic distribution channels.

companies.name: Banco de Crédito del Perú
companies.description: Banco de Crédito del Perú is the largest bank in Peru by total assets and a major provider of integrated financial services. It is the main operating subsidiary of Credicorp, Peru's largest financial holding company. The bank plays a significant role in the Peruvian financial sector.

companies.name: Banco do Brasil
companies.description: Banco do Brasil S.A. is a Brazilian financial services company headquartered in Brasília. Founded in 1808, it is the oldest bank in Brazil and among the oldest in continuous operation worldwide. It is the second largest bank in Brazil and Latin America and is controlled by the Brazilian government.

companies.name: Banco Macro
companies.description: Banco Macro is a private bank in Argentina, recognized as the second largest domestically-owned bank in the country. Established in 1988, it operates a wide network of branches and ATMs, providing banking services to a broad customer base across Argentina.

companies.name: Banco Santander
companies.description: Banco Santander S.A. is a Spanish multinational financial services company headquartered in Santander. It is the fourth largest bank in Europe by assets and operates across Europe, the Americas, and Asia. The bank maintains a presence in most global financial centers.

companies.name: Bank Central Asia
companies.description: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BCA) is an Indonesian universal bank headquartered in Central Jakarta. It is the largest private bank in Indonesia by assets and market capitalization. The bank is controlled by the Hartono family through PT Dwimuria Investama Andalan.

companies.name: Bank Hapoalim
companies.description: Bank Hapoalim is one of Israel's largest banks, established in 1921. It is the second largest bank in Israel by equity and offers a broad range of financial services with a focus on retail banking. The bank operates over 250 branches and offices domestically and internationally.

companies.name: Bank Leumi
companies.description: Bank Leumi is an Israeli bank founded in 1902 in Jaffa as the Anglo-Palestine Company. It is Israel's largest bank and has overseas offices in multiple countries including Luxembourg, the US, Switzerland, and China. The bank was originally established to promote industry and infrastructure in the region.

companies.name: Bank of America
companies.description: Bank of America Corporation is an American multinational bank and financial services holding company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, with investment banking headquarters in Manhattan. It was formed by the merger of NationsBank and the legacy Bank of America in 1998. It is the second-largest banking institution in the US by consolidated assets.

companies.name: Bank Of China
companies.description: Bank of China is a state-owned Chinese multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Beijing. It is one of the big four banks in China and was the second-largest lender in China as of 2019. It is considered a systemically important bank by the Financial Stability Board.

companies.name: Bank Of Ireland
companies.description: Bank of Ireland Group plc is a commercial bank operating in Ireland and one of the traditional Big Four Irish banks. It has a unique position in Irish banking history, with its core being the old Governor and Company of the Bank of Ireland, established by royal charter in 1783.

companies.name: Bank Of Montreal
companies.hq: Bank of Montreal Head Office, Montreal, Canada
companies.description: The Bank of Montreal, abbreviated as BMO, is a Canadian multinational investment bank and financial services company. It operates in the financial services sector and is headquartered in Canada.

companies.name: Barclays
companies.description: Barclays PLC is a British multinational universal bank headquartered in London, England. It operates through five divisions including UK Consumer Bank, UK Corporate Bank, Private Bank and Wealth Management, Investment Bank, and US Consumer Bank.

companies.name: Basf
companies.description: BASF SE is a German multinational company and the largest chemical producer in the world. Its headquarters is located in Ludwigshafen, Germany. The company’s name is an initialism of its original name Badische Anilin- & Soda-Fabrik.

companies.name: Bayer
companies.description: Bayer AG is a German multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company headquartered in Leverkusen. It is one of the largest pharmaceutical and biomedical companies globally, with business areas including pharmaceuticals, consumer healthcare, agricultural chemicals, seeds, and biotechnology products.

companies.name: Bce
companies.description: BCE Inc. is a publicly traded Canadian holding company for Bell Canada, including telecommunications providers and mass media assets under Bell Media Inc. It was founded in 1983 through a corporate reorganization and is headquartered in Montreal, Quebec, Canada.

companies.name: Bdms_Bangkok Dusit Medical
companies.description: Bangkok Dusit Medical Services is Thailand's largest private healthcare group. It was founded by Thai billionaire Prasert Prasarttong-Osoth. The company operates in the healthcare sector.

companies.name: Berkshire Hathaway
companies.description: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. is an American multinational conglomerate holding company headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. Originally a textile manufacturer, it became a conglomerate starting in 1965 under Warren Buffett. Greg Abel succeeded Buffett as CEO in 2026.

companies.name: Bharti Airtel
companies.description: Bharti Airtel is an Indian telecommunications company providing mobile network, broadband, fixed-line, and digital TV services in India and other countries. It operates under its parent company, Bharti Airtel, and offers 5G, 4G, and 4G+ services across India. It is the second largest provider of mobile and fixed telephony in India.

companies.name: BHP
companies.description: BHP Group Limited is an Australian multinational mining and metals corporation headquartered in Melbourne, Victoria. Founded in 1885 as the Broken Hill Proprietary Company, it specializes in mining and selling iron ore, copper, and coal. BHP is a major player in the global mining industry.

companies.name: BIM
companies.description: BİM Birleşik Mağazalar A.Ş. is a Turkish retail company known for pioneering the discount store model in Turkey. It offers a limited range of basic food items and consumer goods at competitive prices. BİM is a notable player in the Turkish retail sector.

companies.name: BNP Paribas
companies.description: BNP Paribas is a French multinational universal bank and financial services holding company headquartered in Paris. Founded in 2000 from the merger of Banque Nationale de Paris and Paribas, it has acquired several major institutions across Europe and had a presence in the US through subsidiaries until recent years. The bank operates in commercial, personal, investment, and corporate banking sectors.

companies.name: Boeing
companies.description: The Boeing Company is an American multinational corporation that designs and manufactures airplanes, rotorcraft, rockets, satellites, and missiles worldwide. Founded in 1916 in Seattle, Washington, it is among the largest global aerospace manufacturers and the fourth-largest defense contractor by revenue. Boeing acquired McDonnell Douglas in 1997.

companies.name: Bp
companies.description: BP p.l.c. is a British multinational oil and gas company headquartered in London, England. It is one of the oil and gas supermajors and operates vertically across exploration, extraction, refining, distribution, marketing, power generation, and trading. BP is one of the largest companies globally by revenue and profits.

companies.name: Bradesco
companies.description: Banco Bradesco S.A. is a Brazilian financial services company headquartered in Osasco, São Paulo. It is the third largest banking institution by assets in Brazil and Latin America and ranks among the fifty most valuable banks worldwide. The bank is listed on the São Paulo, New York, and Madrid stock exchanges.

companies.name: British American Tobacco
companies.description: British American Tobacco p.l.c. (BAT) is a British-American multinational company headquartered in London, England. Established in 1902, it manufactures and sells cigarettes, tobacco, and other nicotine products including electronic cigarettes. As of 2025, it is the second-largest tobacco company globally by net sales.

companies.name: Broadcom
companies.description: Broadcom Inc. is an American multinational company that designs, develops, manufactures, and supplies semiconductor and infrastructure software products. Its offerings serve data center, networking, software, broadband, wireless, storage, and industrial markets. As of 2026, Broadcom is one of the largest companies worldwide.

companies.name: BYD
companies.description: BYD Company Limited is a Chinese multinational manufacturing conglomerate headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong. It is vertically integrated with subsidiaries including BYD Auto for automobiles, BYD Electronics for electronic parts and assembly, and FinDreams producing automotive components and electric vehicle batteries.

companies.name: Caixabank
companies.description: CaixaBank, S.A. is a Spanish multinational financial services company based in Valencia with offices in Barcelona and Madrid. It is Spain's third-largest lender by market value and has the most extensive branch network in the Spanish market.

companies.name: Canadian Natural Resources
companies.description: Canadian Natural Resources Limited is a senior Canadian oil and natural gas company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta. It operates primarily in Western Canadian provinces and offshore locations, and is the largest independent producer of natural gas in Western Canada.

companies.name: Capgemini
companies.description: Capgemini SE is a French multinational information technology services and consulting company headquartered in Paris. Founded in 1974 as Sogeti, it expanded significantly in the 1980s through acquisitions.

companies.name: Capitec Bank
companies.description: Capitec is the largest South African commercial bank by customer base. It is licensed by the Reserve Bank of South Africa, the country's central bank and banking regulator.

companies.name: Carlsberg
companies.description: Carlsberg A/S is a Danish multinational brewer headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark. Founded in 1847, its flagship brand is Carlsberg, and the company is the seventh largest brewery in the world by revenue.

companies.name: Caterpillar
companies.description: Caterpillar Inc. is an American manufacturer of construction, mining, and engineering equipment. It is the world's largest manufacturer of construction equipment.

companies.name: Catl
companies.description: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (CATL) is a Chinese battery manufacturer headquartered in Ningde, Fujian province. Founded in 2011, it specializes in lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage systems and is the largest EV battery manufacturer globally.

companies.name: Celltrion
companies.description: Celltrion, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Incheon, South Korea. Its subsidiary, Celltrion Healthcare, handles worldwide marketing and distribution of its biological medicines.

companies.name: Cemex
companies.description: CEMEX, S.A.B. de C.V., known as Cemex, is a Mexican multinational building materials company headquartered in San Pedro, near Monterrey, Mexico. It manufactures and distributes cement, ready-mix concrete, and aggregates in over 50 countries.

companies.name: Cencosud
companies.description: Cencosud S.A. is a publicly traded retail company based in Chile. It is the largest retail company in Chile and the third largest listed retail company in Latin America. The company operates more than 1045 stores across Latin America.

companies.name: Central Puerto
companies.description: Central Puerto S.A. is an Argentine energy provider headquartered in Buenos Aires. It is involved in the development of energy generation both nationally and internationally. The company is publicly listed on the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange's S&P Merval index.

companies.name: Check Point Software
companies.description: Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. is an Israeli cybersecurity company based in Tel Aviv. Founded in 1993, it sells network firewalls and security products for various platforms including cloud and mobile devices. The company has been publicly traded on Nasdaq since 1996.

companies.name: Chevron
companies.description: Chevron Corporation is an American multinational energy corporation specializing in oil and gas. It is the second-largest direct descendant of Standard Oil and operates in more than 180 countries. The company was originally known as the Standard Oil Company of California.

companies.name: China Merchants Bank
companies.description: China Merchants Bank is a Chinese bank headquartered in Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong. Founded in 1987, it was the first share-holding commercial bank wholly owned by corporate legal entities in China. The bank is listed on both the Shanghai and Hong Kong Stock Exchanges.

companies.name: China Mobile
companies.description: China Mobile is a Chinese state-owned telecommunications company providing mobile voice and multimedia services across mainland China and Hong Kong. It is the largest wireless carrier in China. The company is controlled by China Mobile Communications Group Co., Ltd.

companies.name: Chubb
companies.description: Chubb Limited is an American–Swiss insurance company incorporated in Zürich. It is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and is a component of the S&P 500 index. The company operates in the insurance industry.

companies.name: Chunghwa Telecom
companies.description: Chunghwa Telecom Co., Ltd. is the largest integrated telecommunications service provider in Taiwan. It offers PSTN, mobile phone, and broadband services. The company is operated by PCCW.

companies.name: Cimb
companies.description: CIMB Group Holdings Berhad is a Malaysian universal bank headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. It operates in high growth economies in ASEAN and is an indigenous ASEAN investment bank. CIMB has a wide retail branch network with 1,080 branches across the region.

companies.name: Citic Securities
companies.description: CITIC Securities Co., Ltd. is a Chinese full-service investment bank under CITIC Group. It offers underwriting, research, brokerage, asset management, wealth management, and investment advisory services. The company was established in 1995 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

companies.name: Cnooc
companies.description: CNOOC Limited is China's largest producer of offshore crude oil and natural gas. It is a major subsidiary of China National Offshore Oil Corporation and has been listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 2001. The company was also listed on the New York and Toronto Stock Exchanges until 2021.

companies.name: Coca-Cola
companies.description: Coca-Cola is a cola soft drink manufactured by the Coca-Cola Company, based in the United States. Its products are sold in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. Coca-Cola was ranked as the world's sixth most valuable brand in 2023.

companies.name: Coca-Cola Femsa
companies.description: Coca-Cola FEMSA is a Mexican multinational beverage company headquartered in Mexico City. It is the largest franchise Coca-Cola bottler in the world with operations mainly in Latin America. FEMSA owns 47.8% of the company, with other shares held by The Coca-Cola Company and public investors.

companies.name: Coloplast
companies.description: Coloplast A/S is a Danish multinational company that develops, manufactures, and markets medical devices and services. Its products focus on ostomy, urology, continence, and wound care. The company operates in the healthcare sector.

companies.name: Commercial International Bank
companies.description: Commercial International Bank (CIB) is a major Egyptian bank founded in 1975. It is considered one of the largest banks in Egypt's private sector. The bank provides various financial services within Egypt.

companies.name: Commerzbank
companies.industry: Financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
companies.description: Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft is a European banking institution headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. It offers services to private, business, and corporate customers. The Commerzbank Group includes the Polish subsidiary mBank.

companies.name: Commonwealth Bank
companies.description: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia is an Australian multinational bank with operations in New Zealand, Asia, the United States, and the United Kingdom. It provides a variety of financial services including banking, funds management, insurance, and investment. The bank owns several brands such as Bankwest and CommSec.

companies.name: Compass
companies.description: Compass Group plc is a British multinational contract foodservice company headquartered in Chertsey, England. It is the largest contract foodservice company in Europe, serving meals in various locations including offices, schools, hospitals, and offshore oil platforms. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: ConocoPhillips
companies.description: ConocoPhillips Company is an American multinational corporation engaged in hydrocarbon exploration and production. It is based in the Energy Corridor district of Houston, Texas. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

companies.name: Consolidated Edison
companies.description: Consolidated Edison, Inc., known as Con Edison or ConEd, is an energy company based in New York City. It is one of the largest investor-owned energy companies in the United States, providing electric, gas, and steam services through its subsidiaries. The company also invests in electric and natural gas transmission projects.

companies.name: Constellation Software
companies.description: Constellation Software Inc. is a Canadian vertical market software company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. It is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the ticker CSU and is a constituent of the S&P/TSX 60. The company specializes in IT service management software.

companies.name: Contact Energy
companies.description: Contact Energy Limited is a New Zealand company that generates electricity, wholesales natural gas, and retails electricity, natural gas, broadband, and LPG. It operates in the energy sector providing multiple utility services.

companies.name: CoreWeave
companies.description: CoreWeave, Inc. is an American cloud-computing company based in Livingston, New Jersey. As of 2026, it operates 51 AI data centers designed for high parallel computing performance using graphics processing units (GPUs).

companies.name: Costco Wholesale
companies.description: Costco Wholesale Corporation is an American multinational that operates membership-only big-box warehouse club retail stores. It is one of the largest retailers globally and ranks 12th on the Fortune 500 list as of 2026.

companies.name: CP All
companies.description: CP All Public Company Limited, established in 1988 by the Charoen Pokphand Group, operates convenience stores in Thailand under the 7-Eleven trademark. The first 7-Eleven outlet in Thailand opened in 1989 on Patpong Road.

companies.name: Crown Castle
companies.description: Crown Castle Inc. is a US-based real estate investment trust headquartered in Houston, Texas. It owns, operates, and leases approximately 40,000 cell towers across the United States, providing shared communications infrastructure nationwide.

companies.name: CSL
companies.description: CSL Limited is an Australian multinational specialty biotechnology company that researches, develops, manufactures, and markets products to treat and prevent serious human medical conditions. Founded in 1916, it was government-owned until its privatization in 1994.

companies.name: Ctbc Financial
companies.description: CTBC Financial Holding Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese holding company principally engaged in the finance industry through eight major subsidiaries. It was founded by Jeffrey Koo Sr. and is part of the Koos Group.

companies.name: Daikin Industries
companies.description: Daikin Industries, Ltd. is a Japanese multinational conglomerate headquartered in Osaka. The company operates in the electronics industry.

companies.name: Daimler Truck
companies.description: Daimler Truck AG is the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Leinfelden-Echterdingen, Germany. It has over 35 main locations worldwide and was part of Daimler AG from 2019 to 2021.

companies.name: Danone
companies.description: Danone is a French multinational food-products corporation based in Paris. Founded in 1919 in Barcelona, Spain, it is listed on Euronext Paris and is a component of the CAC 40 stock market index. In 2020, Danone became the first listed company to adopt the status of société à mission under France's PACTE law.

companies.name: Danske Bank
companies.description: Danske Bank A/S is a Danish multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Copenhagen. It is the largest bank in Denmark and a major retail bank in northern Europe with over 5 million retail customers.

companies.name: Dassault Systemes
companies.description: Dassault Systèmes SE is a French multinational software corporation that develops software for 3D product design, simulation, manufacturing, and other 3D related products.

companies.name: DBS
companies.description: DBS Bank Limited is a Singaporean multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered at the Marina Bay Financial Centre in Singapore. Formerly known as The Development Bank of Singapore Limited, it is one of the "Big Three" local banks in Singapore.

companies.name: Deere &
companies.description: Deere & Company is an American corporation that manufactures agricultural machinery, heavy equipment, forestry machinery, diesel engines, drivetrains for heavy equipment, and lawn care equipment. It also provides financial services and related activities.

companies.name: Dell Technologies
companies.description: Dell Technologies Inc. is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Round Rock, Texas. Formed in 2016 from the merger of Dell Inc. and EMC Corporation, it produces personal computers, servers, monitors, software, and security services.

companies.name: Delta Electronic
companies.description: Delta Electronics, Inc. is a Taiwanese electronics manufacturing company headquartered in Neihu, Taipei. It is known for DC industrial and computer fans, data center rectifiers, liquid cooling systems, and switching power supplies, operating about 200 facilities worldwide.

companies.name: Denso
companies.description: Denso Corporation is a global automotive components manufacturer headquartered in Kariya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan.

companies.name: Deutsche Telekom
companies.description: Deutsche Telekom AG is a partially state-owned German telecommunications company headquartered in Bonn. It operates several subsidiaries worldwide, including the mobile communications brand T-Mobile.

companies.name: Dhl
companies.description: DHL is a multinational logistics company founded in the United States and headquartered in Bonn, Germany. It provides courier, package delivery, and express mail services, delivering over 1.7 billion parcels annually, and operates DHL Express, a leading parcel service in Europe.

companies.name: Diageo
companies.description: Diageo plc is a British multinational alcoholic beverage company headquartered in London, England. It operates in 180 countries with 110 sites and owns brands such as Guinness, Johnnie Walker, and Smirnoff. Diageo produces 40% of all Scotch whisky through its distilleries and is listed on the London and New York Stock Exchanges.

companies.name: Digital Realty
companies.description: Digital Realty is an American real estate investment trust that owns, operates, and invests in carrier-neutral data centers worldwide. Founded in 2004 by GI Partners, it offers data center, colocation, and interconnection services. As of June 2023, it has over 300 facilities in more than 25 countries.

companies.name: Dnb Bank
companies.description: DNB Bank ASA is Norway's largest financial services group headquartered in Oslo. It holds total combined assets exceeding NOK 3.6 trillion as of 2024. The bank is a major player in Norway's financial sector.

companies.name: Dominion Energy
companies.description: Dominion Energy, Inc. is an American energy company based in Richmond, Virginia. It supplies electricity in parts of Virginia, North Carolina, and South Carolina, and natural gas to South Carolina and formerly other states. The company also operates generation facilities in several states including Indiana and Connecticut.

companies.name: Dow
companies.description: The Dow Chemical Company is an American multinational corporation headquartered in Midland, Michigan. It was among the three largest chemical producers globally in 2021. Dow Chemical operates as a subsidiary of Dow Inc., a publicly traded holding company incorporated in Delaware.

companies.name: Dsv
companies.description: DSV A/S is a Danish transport and logistics company providing global transport services by road, air, sea, and train. Founded in 1976 by nine independent Danish hauliers, it has expanded mainly through acquisitions of competitors.

companies.name: Duke Energy
companies.description: Duke Energy Corporation is an American electric power and natural gas holding company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It serves over 7 million customers in the eastern United States. In 2024, it achieved its highest-ever ranking on the Fortune 500 list at 141st.

companies.name: Eaton
companies.description: Eaton Corporation plc is an American-Irish multinational power management company with global headquarters in Dublin and a primary administrative center in Beachwood, Ohio. It employs over 85,000 people and sells products in more than 175 countries worldwide.

companies.name: Ecopetrol
companies.description: Ecopetrol is the largest petroleum company in Colombia, formerly known as Empresa Colombiana de Petróleo S.A. It is part of the Fortune Global 500 and was ranked among the largest public companies globally by Forbes and CNN Money in recent years.

companies.name: EDP
companies.description: EDP is a Portuguese electric utilities company headquartered in Lisbon. It was founded in 1976 through the merger of 14 nationalised electricity companies. EDP operates in the electricity supply sector.

companies.name: Elbit Systems
companies.description: Elbit Systems Ltd. is an Israel-based international military technology company and defense contractor. Founded in 1966 by Elron, it is the primary provider of the Israeli military's land-based equipment and unmanned aerial vehicles. The company plays an important role in Israel's defense industry.

companies.name: Eli Lilly
companies.description: Eli Lilly and Company is an American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Founded in 1876 by Eli Lilly, a pharmaceutical chemist and Union army veteran, the company markets its products in approximately 90 countries and has offices in 36 countries.

companies.name: Elisa
companies.description: Elisa Corporation is a Finnish telecommunications company founded in 1882. It was formerly known as HPY until July 2000, and its mobile operations were previously called Radiolinja. The company operates primarily in Finland.

companies.name: Emaar Properties
companies.description: Emaar Properties is a real estate development company based in the United Arab Emirates. The two largest shareholders are Dubai Holding, controlled by Dubai ruler Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, and the Investment Corporation of Dubai, the emirate's sovereign wealth fund.

companies.name: Emerson Electric
companies.description: Emerson Electric Co., commonly known as Emerson, is an American multinational corporation headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. It manufactures and delivers industrial automation and control systems, climate control solutions, measurement and analytical instrumentation, and provides engineering services for various markets.

companies.name: Emirates NBD
companies.description: Emirates NBD Bank PJSC is a major bank in the United Arab Emirates and is considered one of the Big Four banks in the country. It operates primarily in the financial sector within the UAE.

companies.name: Empresas Copec
companies.description: Empresas Copec is a Chilean company operating in the energy and forestry sectors. It also runs a chain of gas stations throughout Chile, serving the country's petroleum market.

companies.name: Enbridge
companies.description: Enbridge Inc. is a Canadian pipeline and energy company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta. It owns and operates the longest pipeline system in North America, transporting crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids across Canada and the United States, and also generates renewable energy.

companies.name: Endesa,S.A
companies.description: Endesa, S.A. is the largest Spanish multinational electric utility company. It is majority-owned by the Italian utility company Enel and serves over 20 million customers domestically and internationally, generating electricity from nuclear, fossil-fueled, hydroelectric, and renewable sources.

companies.name: Enel
companies.description: Enel S.p.A. is an Italian multinational producer and distributor of electricity and gas. Established as a public body in 1962 and privatized in 1999, the Italian state remains the largest shareholder. Enel operates primarily in the energy industry.

companies.name: Enel Americas
companies.description: Enel Americas is a conglomerate of electric energy companies operating in South and Central America, including Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Costa Rica, Panama, and Guatemala. It generates, transmits, and distributes electric power through its affiliates. The company is based in Chile.

companies.name: Engie
companies.description: Engie SA is a French multinational electric utility company headquartered in La Défense, Courbevoie. It operates in electricity generation and distribution, natural gas, nuclear power, renewable energy, district energy, and petroleum industries. The company is involved in both upstream and downstream activities.

companies.name: Eni
companies.description: Eni S.p.A. is an Italian multinational energy company considered one of the world's supermajor oil companies. The Italian government holds a golden share in the company. Eni is a component of the Euro Stoxx 50 stock market index.

companies.name: Enphase Energy
companies.description: Enphase Energy, Inc. is an American energy technology company headquartered in Fremont, California. It develops and manufactures solar micro-inverters, battery energy storage, and EV charging stations primarily for residential customers. Enphase was the first company to successfully commercialize solar micro-inverters.

companies.name: EOG Resources
companies.description: EOG Resources, Inc. is an American energy company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration. It is organized in Delaware and headquartered in the Heritage Plaza building in Houston, Texas.

companies.name: Equinix
companies.description: Equinix Inc. is an American multinational internet and data center company headquartered in Redwood City, California. It specializes in internet connectivity and data center colocation centers and converted to a real estate investment trust in January 2015. The company operates 260 data centers in 33 countries.

companies.name: Equinor
companies.description: Equinor ASA is a Norwegian multinational energy company headquartered in Stavanger, Norway. It primarily operates in petroleum across 36 countries and has investments in renewable energy and lithium mining. The company was ranked 52nd in the 2023 Forbes Global 2000 list.

companies.name: Erste
companies.description: Erste Group Bank AG is an Austrian financial service provider headquartered in Vienna. It is one of the largest financial service providers in Central and Eastern Europe, serving over 23 million clients through more than 2,000 branches in eight countries. The bank operates as a universal bank.

companies.name: Essilorluxottica
companies.description: EssilorLuxottica SA is a Franco-Italian multinational holding company registered in Charenton-Le-Pont and headquartered in Paris and Milan. It designs, produces, and markets ophthalmic lenses, equipment, prescription glasses, and sunglasses. The company was founded in 2018 from the merger of French Essilor and Italian Luxottica.

companies.name: Essity
companies.description: Essity AB is a Swedish multinational company headquartered in Stockholm that specializes in hygiene and health products. It was established in 2017 as a spin-off from Svenska Cellulosa Aktiebolaget (SCA). Essity operates in approximately 150 countries and serves more than one billion people worldwide.

companies.name: Eurobank
companies.description: Eurobank is a financial organization operating in Greece, Cyprus, Luxembourg, Bulgaria, and the UK. It has a network of 562 branches and employs over 12,000 people. Eurobank is part of the Eurobank Group, which manages significant assets across these countries.

companies.name: Evolution
companies.description: Evolution AB is a Swedish gaming technology company headquartered in Stockholm. It develops and licenses live casino software for online casino operators on a B2B basis. The company focuses on providing technology solutions for the online gambling industry.

companies.name: Exelon
companies.description: Exelon Corporation is an American public utility headquartered in Chicago and incorporated in Pennsylvania. It is the largest regulated electric utility in the United States by revenue, serving approximately 10 million customers. Exelon is ranked 187th on the Fortune 500 list.

companies.name: Experian
companies.description: Experian plc is a multinational data broker and consumer credit reporting company headquartered in Dublin, Ireland. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index. Experian is one of the "Big Three" credit reporting agencies alongside TransUnion and Equifax.

companies.name: Falabella
companies.description: Falabella is a multinational chain of department stores owned by the Chilean company S.A.C.I. Falabella. It is the largest department store chain in South America and a member of the International Association of Department Stores. The company operates across multiple countries in the region.

companies.name: FedEx
companies.description: FedEx Corporation is an American multinational company headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, specializing in transportation, e-commerce, and business services. Founded in 1971, it began operations in 1973 as an express delivery company. FedEx offers parcel delivery, freight forwarding, logistics, customs brokerage, and supply-chain services worldwide.

companies.name: FEMSA
companies.description: Fomento Económico Mexicano, S.A.B. de C.V. (FEMSA) is a Mexican multinational beverage and retail company headquartered in Monterrey, Mexico. It operates the largest independent Coca-Cola bottling group globally and runs the largest convenience store chain in Mexico.

companies.name: Ferrari
companies.description: Ferrari S.p.A. is an Italian luxury sports car manufacturer based in Maranello, Italy. Founded in 1939 by Enzo Ferrari, the company began producing its current line of road cars in 1947. Ferrari was a subsidiary of Fiat S.p.A. from 1963 to 2014 and was spun off in 2016; it offers a range including supercars, grand tourers, and an SUV.

companies.name: Ferrovial
companies.description: Ferrovial S.E. is a Spanish multinational company operating in the infrastructure sector for transportation and mobility. It has four divisions: Highways, Airports, Construction, and Mobility and Energy Infrastructure. Ferrovial is present in more than 20 countries and manages projects including toll highways and renewable energy initiatives.

companies.name: FirstRand
companies.description: FirstRand Limited is a South African financial services holding company and the largest listed financial services institution in Africa. It operates across Africa, the UK, and India and is licensed by the Reserve Bank of South Africa. The company manages assets worth over R1.7 trillion.

companies.name: Fisher & Paykel Healthcare
companies.description: Fisher & Paykel Healthcare Corporation Limited is a New Zealand-based manufacturer and marketer of respiratory care and acute care products, including treatments for obstructive sleep apnea. Its products are sold in around 120 countries, with most revenue generated outside New Zealand.

companies.name: Fletcher Building
companies.description: Fletcher Building Limited is a construction management company based in New Zealand. The summary identifies it specifically as a New Zealand construction management firm.

companies.name: Ford Motor
companies.description: Ford Motor Company is an American multinational automobile manufacturer headquartered in Dearborn, Michigan. Founded in 1903 by Henry Ford, it sells vehicles under the Ford and Lincoln brands and is controlled by the Ford family.

companies.name: Ford Otosan
companies.description: Ford Otosan is a Turkish automotive manufacturing company equally owned by Ford Motor Company and Koç Holding. Established in 1977, it operates six locations including plants in Turkey and Romania, employing over 20,000 people.

companies.name: Formosa Plastic
companies.description: Formosa Plastics Corporation is a Taiwanese plastics company based in Kaohsiung that produces polyvinyl chloride resins and other intermediate plastic products. It is central to the Formosa Plastics Group's petrochemical operations and is led by president Jason Lin.

companies.name: Fortescue
companies.description: Fortescue is an Australian global metal mining and energy company headquartered in Australia. It is the fourth-largest iron ore producer worldwide and holds the largest mining tenements in Western Australia's Pilbara region.

companies.name: Fortum
companies.description: Fortum Oyj is a Finnish state-owned energy company based in Espoo, Finland, focusing on the Nordic region. It operates power plants and sells electricity, heat, and energy-related services, and is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki stock exchange.

companies.name: Fpt
companies.description: FPT Corporation is a Vietnamese multinational information technology company headquartered in Hanoi. Founded in 1988, it operates in technology, telecommunications, and education, with IT services as its largest business and Japan as its biggest foreign market.

companies.name: Freeport-McMoRan
companies.description: Freeport-McMoRan Inc. is an American mining company headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona. It is the world's largest producer of molybdenum and a major copper producer. The company operates the world's largest gold mine, the Grasberg mine in Papua, Indonesia.

companies.name: Galp
companies.description: Galp Energia is a Portuguese multinational energy corporation based in Lisbon, Portugal. It operates in oil and natural gas supply, exploration, production, refining, trading, logistics, retailing, co-generation, and renewable energy. Founded in 1999, it is the largest oil and gas group in Portugal.

companies.name: GameStop
companies.description: GameStop Corp. is an American retailer of video games, consumer electronics, and gaming merchandise headquartered in Grapevine, Texas. It is the largest video game retailer worldwide, operating over 2,200 stores globally under various brand names. The company was founded in Dallas in 1984 as Babbage's and renamed GameStop in 1999.

companies.name: Garanti Bankasi
companies.description: Garanti BBVA is a Turkish financial services company based in Turkey. The majority stake, 86%, is owned by the Spanish bank Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria (BBVA).

companies.name: GE Aerospace
companies.description: General Electric Company is an American aircraft engine supplier headquartered in Evendale, Ohio. It is the legal successor to the original General Electric Company founded in 1892. The company adopted the trade name GE Aerospace after divesting its healthcare and energy divisions between 2021 and 2024.

companies.name: General Dynamics
companies.description: General Dynamics Corporation is an American industrial and technology company based in Reston, Virginia. It develops and produces advanced military equipment including nuclear submarines, tanks, and armored vehicles. The company also manufactures Gulfstream business jets and provides IT services, ranking as the third largest U.S. federal government contractor.

companies.name: General Motors
companies.description: General Motors Company is an American multinational automotive manufacturer headquartered in Detroit, Michigan. It owns and manufactures the automobile brands Chevrolet, Buick, GMC, and Cadillac. GM was the largest automaker in the United States by total sales and held the global top spot for 77 years until 2008.

companies.name: Generali
companies.description: Assicurazioni Generali S.p.A., commonly known as Generali Group, is an Italian insurance company based in Trieste. As of 2022, it is the largest insurance company in Italy and ranks among the world's largest insurance companies by net premiums and assets.

companies.name: Genmab
companies.description: Genmab A/S is a Danish biotechnology company founded in 1999 and based in Copenhagen, Denmark. It operates internationally through subsidiaries in the Netherlands, the US, Japan, Germany, and China. Genmab is listed on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange and has American depositary receipts traded on NASDAQ.

companies.name: Givaudan
companies.description: Givaudan S.A. is a Swiss multinational manufacturer of flavours, fragrances, and active cosmetic ingredients. As of 2025, it is the world's largest company in the flavour and fragrance industry.

companies.name: Glanbia
companies.description: Glanbia plc is an Irish multinational nutrition company headquartered in Kilkenny, Ireland. It owns consumer brands producing food supplements and ingredients, with products sold in over 130 countries. The company operates through three divisions: Glanbia Nutritionals, Glanbia Performance Nutrition, and Joint Ventures.

companies.name: Gold Fields
companies.description: Gold Fields Limited is a gold mining company headquartered in Johannesburg, South Africa. It was formed in 1998 from the amalgamation of Gold Fields of South Africa Limited and Gencor Limited. The company is listed on the Johannesburg and New York Stock Exchanges and is one of the world's largest gold producers.

companies.name: Goldman Sachs
companies.description: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is an American multinational investment bank and financial services company headquartered in Manhattan, New York City. Founded in 1869, it operates offices worldwide and is considered a systemically important financial institution.

companies.name: Grupo Financiero Banorte
companies.description: Grupo Financiero Banorte, S.A.B. de C.V., known as Banorte and Ixe, is a Mexican banking and financial services holding company headquartered in Monterrey and Mexico City. It is one of Mexico's four largest commercial banks and the largest retirement fund administrator.

companies.name: Grupo Financiero Galicia
companies.description: Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A. is a financial services holding company based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Its banking operations are the fifth largest in Argentina and the largest among domestically owned private banks in the country.

companies.name: Gsk
companies.description: GSK plc is a British multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company headquartered in London, England. It was established in 2000 through the merger of Glaxo Wellcome and SmithKline Beecham, both pharmaceutical companies.

companies.name: The Hartford
companies.description: The Hartford Insurance Group, Inc., known as The Hartford, is an insurance company headquartered in Hartford, Connecticut, USA. It has been the auto and home insurance writer for AARP members for over 40 years and is a Fortune 500 company.

companies.name: Hcl Technologies
companies.description: HCL Group is an Indian multinational conglomerate operating in sectors such as information technology, healthcare, education, and semiconductor manufacturing. Its largest subsidiary, HCLTech, provides IT consulting and engineering services to various industries including financial services and telecommunications.

companies.name: HDFC Bank
companies.description: HDFC Bank Limited is an Indian banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It was incorporated in 1994 and began operations in 1995 after receiving its banking license. It is India's largest private sector bank by assets and market capitalization.

companies.name: Henkel
companies.description: Henkel AG & Co. KGaA is a German multinational chemical and consumer goods company headquartered in Düsseldorf. Founded in 1876, it operates globally with well-known brands such as Loctite, Persil, and Pritt.

companies.name: Hindustan Unilever
companies.description: Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL) is an Indian fast-moving consumer goods company headquartered in Mumbai. It is a subsidiary of the Anglo-Dutch company Unilever and produces foods, beverages, cleaning agents, and personal care products.

companies.name: Hitachi
companies.description: Hitachi, Ltd. is a Japanese multinational conglomerate founded in 1910 and headquartered in Chiyoda, Tokyo. It operates in various industries including digital systems, power and renewable energy, railway systems, healthcare products, and financial systems.

companies.name: Holcim
companies.description: Holcim is a Swiss-based global building materials and aggregates division of the Holcim Group. The original company merged with Lafarge in 2015 to form LafargeHolcim, renamed Holcim Group in 2021, with the Holcim brand remaining active within the group.

companies.name: Honda Motor
companies.description: Honda Motor Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational conglomerate automotive manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo. It is commonly known as Honda and operates globally in the automotive industry.

companies.name: Honeywell
companies.description: Honeywell International Inc. was an American multinational automation corporation headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It operated in building automation, industrial automation, and energy and sustainability solutions, and managed Sandia National Laboratories under contract with the U.S. Department of Energy.

companies.name: Hoya
companies.description: Hoya Corporation is a Japanese company manufacturing optical products including photomasks, contact lenses, eyeglass lenses, medical photonics, lasers, and medical flexible endoscopy equipment. It is recognized as one of the Forbes Global 2000 Leading Companies.

companies.name: HSBC
companies.description: HSBC Holdings plc is a British universal bank and financial services group headquartered in London, England. It has historical and business links to East Asia and is one of the largest banks in Europe and the world by assets. HSBC operates globally with a multinational footprint.

companies.name: Hsbc
companies.description: The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited is the Hong Kong–based Asia-Pacific subsidiary of the British HSBC banking group. It is the largest bank in Hong Kong and operates branches throughout the Indo-Pacific region and other countries. It is one of three commercial banks licensed to issue Hong Kong dollar banknotes.

companies.name: Huntington Ingalls
companies.description: Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc. is the largest military shipbuilding company in the United States. It also provides professional services to government and industry partners. The company was formed in 2011 as a divestiture from Northrop Grumman.

companies.name: Hyundai Motor
companies.description: The Hyundai Motor Group is a South Korean chaebol headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It operates in the automotive industry. The group is a major player in its sector based in South Korea.

companies.name: Icici Bank
companies.description: ICICI Bank is an Indian multinational private bank and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. Established in 1955 with support from the World Bank and the Government of India, it offers services to corporate and retail customers and has subsidiaries in investment banking, insurance, venture capital, and asset management.

companies.name: Icl
companies.description: ICL Group Ltd. is a multinational manufacturing company based in Israel that develops, produces, and markets fertilizers, metals, and special-purpose chemical products. It serves agriculture, food, and engineered materials markets and is a major global producer of bromine and potash.

companies.name: Ihh
companies.description: IHH Healthcare Berhad is a multinational private healthcare group headquartered in Singapore and Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It operates 190 healthcare facilities including 89 hospitals across 10 countries and employs 76,000 people in Asia and Europe. The company is listed on Bursa Malaysia and the Singapore Exchange.

companies.name: Imperial Brands
companies.description: Imperial Brands plc is a British multinational tobacco company headquartered in Bristol, England. It is the world's largest producer of fine-cut tobacco and tobacco papers. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Ab Inbev
companies.description: InBev was a brewing company formed by the merger of Belgium-based Interbrew and Brazilian brewer AmBev in 2004. It operated in over 30 countries with sales in over 130 countries. In 2008, it acquired Anheuser-Busch to form Anheuser-Busch InBev.

companies.name: Inditex
companies.description: Industria de Diseño Textil, S.A. (Inditex) is a Spanish multinational clothing company headquartered in Arteixo, Galicia, Spain. It is the largest fast fashion group globally, operating over 7,200 stores in 93 markets. Its main brand is Zara, alongside several other fashion brands.

companies.name: Infineon Technologies
companies.description: Infineon Technologies AG is a German company that designs and manufactures semiconductor devices. It supplies parts for automotive, power, and security systems. In 2023, it was Germany's largest chip manufacturer.

companies.name: Infosys
companies.description: Infosys Limited is an Indian multinational technology company headquartered in Bengaluru. Founded in 1981 by seven engineers, it offers IT, business consulting, and outsourcing services. It is considered one of the Big Six Indian IT companies.

companies.name: Infratil
companies.description: Infratil Limited is a New Zealand-based infrastructure investment company with assets in renewable energy, digital infrastructure, airports, and healthcare. It operates in New Zealand, Australia, Asia, the US, and Europe. The company was founded by Lloyd Morrison and is managed by Morrison & Co.

companies.name: Ing Groep
companies.description: The ING Group is a Dutch multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Amsterdam. It operates in retail, commercial, investment, wholesale, private banking, and asset management. It ranks among the largest banks globally by total assets.

companies.name: Intel
companies.description: Intel Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It designs, manufactures, and sells computer components including CPUs for business and consumer markets. Intel has been on the Fortune 500 list since 2007 and was among the largest semiconductor manufacturers in 2024.

companies.name: Intesa Sanpaolo
companies.description: Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. is an Italian international banking group formed in 2007 by merging Banca Intesa and Sanpaolo IMI. It is Italy's largest bank by assets and the world's 38th largest. The group has headquarters in Milan and Turin, each housing different banking divisions.

companies.name: Investor
companies.description: Investor AB is a Swedish investment and holding company serving as the investment arm of the Wallenberg family. It is one of Sweden's largest companies and operates as a conglomerate with primary industries including pharmaceuticals, telecommunications, and industry.

companies.name: Itaú Unibanco
companies.description: Banco Itaú Unibanco S.A. is a Brazilian financial services company headquartered in São Paulo. Formed in 2008 by merging Banco Itaú and Unibanco, it is the largest bank in Brazil and Latin America. The bank is listed on the São Paulo and New York stock exchanges.

companies.name: Itc
companies.description: ITC Limited is an Indian conglomerate headquartered in Kolkata. It operates across six business segments including FMCG, agribusiness, IT, paper products, and packaging. The company generates a plurality of its revenue from tobacco products.

companies.name: Itochu
companies.description: Itochu Corporation is a Japanese corporation based in Umeda, Kita-ku, Osaka and Aoyama, Minato, Tokyo. It operates as a general trading company. The company is headquartered in two major Japanese cities, Osaka and Tokyo.

companies.name: Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Company Ltd. is a Chinese pharmaceutical company that manufactures and distributes various drug packaging materials and medications including cancer treatments and cardiovascular drugs. It is the largest listed pharmaceutical company in China.

companies.name: Johnson & Johnson
companies.description: Johnson & Johnson is an American multinational corporation headquartered in New Brunswick, New Jersey, specializing in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical technologies. It is ranked No. 42 on the 2026 Fortune 500 list and holds a prime credit rating of AAA from S&P Global.

companies.name: JPMorgan Chase
companies.description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is an American multinational banking institution headquartered in New York City and incorporated in Delaware. It is the largest bank in the United States and the world's largest bank by market capitalization as of 2026.

companies.name: Js Comm Bank Foreign Trade Viet
companies.legal_name: Js Comm Bank Foreign Trade Viet

listings.name: Js Comm Bank Foreign Trade Viet

companies.name: Kakao
companies.description: Kakao Corporation is a South Korean internet conglomerate headquartered in Jeju City. It was formed through the merger of Daum Communications and the original Kakao Inc. in 2010 and was renamed Daum Kakao in 2014 before reverting to Kakao in 2015.

companies.name: Kbank_Kasikornbank
companies.description: Kasikornbank, often stylised as KBank, is a banking group in Thailand established in 1945 by Choti Lamsam. It was formerly known as the Thai Farmers Bank and has been listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand since 1976.

companies.name: Kbc
companies.description: KBC Group N.V. is a Belgian universal multi-channel bank-insurer focusing on private clients and SMEs in Belgium and several Central European countries. It was created in 1998 through the merger of Kredietbank, CERA Bank, ABB Insurance, and Fidelitas Insurance.

companies.name: Keppel
companies.description: Keppel Ltd., previously Keppel Corporation, is a Singaporean company headquartered in Keppel Bay Tower, HarbourFront. It operates in more than 20 countries and since 2024 is organized into four main business platforms: Infrastructure, Real Estate, Connectivity, and Fund Management & Investment.

companies.name: Kering
companies.description: Kering S.A. is a French multinational holding company specializing in luxury goods. Headquartered in Paris, it owns several luxury brands including Gucci, Yves Saint Laurent, and Balenciaga.

companies.name: Kerry
companies.description: Kerry Group plc is an Irish food ingredients company headquartered in Tralee, County Kerry. It supplies taste and nutrition ingredients to food, beverage, and pharmaceutical manufacturers and focuses on business-to-business taste and nutrition operations following the sale of Kerry Dairy Ireland in 2024.

companies.name: Keyence
companies.description: Keyence Corporation is a Japan-based direct sales organization that develops and manufactures equipment for factory automation. Its products include sensors, measuring instruments, vision systems, barcode readers, laser markers, and digital microscopes. The company is headquartered in Japan.

companies.name: Kia
companies.description: Kia Corporation is a South Korean multinational automobile manufacturer headquartered in Seoul. It is South Korea's second-largest automobile manufacturer and is majority-owned by Hyundai Motor Company. Kia produces and sells vehicles globally.

companies.name: Kingdom
companies.description: The Kingdom Holding Company is a Saudi holding company based in Riyadh. It is listed on the Saudi stock exchange. The company operates as a holding entity in Saudi Arabia.

companies.name: KLA
companies.description: KLA Corporation is an American company based in Milpitas, California that makes wafer fabrication equipment. It supplies process control and yield management systems for the semiconductor and nanoelectronics industries. Its products support all phases of wafer and integrated circuit production.

companies.name: Komercni Banka
