companies.description: Komerční banka is a major Czech bank and the parent company of KB Group, part of the Société Générale financial group. It provides retail, corporate, and investment banking services in the Czech Republic and Slovakia. The bank serves over 1.6 million customers through 399 branches.

companies.name: KONE
companies.description: Kone Oyj is a Finnish multinational elevator engineering company headquartered in Espoo, Finland. Founded in 1910, it employs over 60,000 people worldwide. Kone builds and services elevators, escalators, moving walkways, automatic doors, and gates.

companies.name: Kongsberg Gruppen
companies.description: Kongsberg Gruppen ASA is a Norwegian multinational company based in Kongsberg. It supplies high-technology systems to customers in merchant marine, defence, aerospace, offshore oil and gas, renewable, and utilities industries. The company operates in multiple advanced technology sectors.

companies.name: Koninklijke Ahold Delhaize
companies.description: Koninklijke Ahold Delhaize N.V. is a Dutch multinational retail and wholesale holding company formed by the 2016 merger of Ahold and Delhaize Group. It operates supermarkets, convenience stores, hypermarkets, pharmacies, and liquor stores across nine countries. The company employs 402,000 people and generates most revenue in the United States.

companies.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank
companies.description: Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited is an Indian banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It offers banking, securities, asset management, insurance, and lending services. The company operates primarily in India.

companies.name: Kpn Kon
companies.description: Koninklijke KPN N.V., trading as KPN, is a Dutch telecommunications company based in Rotterdam. It originated from a government-run postal, telegraph, and telephone service. KPN provides telecommunications services in the Netherlands.

companies.name: Kweichow Moutai
companies.description: Kweichow Moutai Co. Ltd. is a Chinese company that produces, sells, and distributes Maotai liquor, a specific style of jiangxiang baijiu. The company is known for its specialization in this traditional Chinese liquor.

companies.name: L’Oréal
companies.description: L'Oréal S.A. is a French multinational personal care corporation headquartered in Clichy, Hauts-de-Seine. It is the world's largest cosmetics company and owns 36 brands and 497 patents as of the early 2020s.

companies.name: L3Harris
companies.description: L3Harris Technologies, Inc. is an American technology company and defense contractor that produces command and control systems, wireless equipment, tactical radios, avionics, night vision equipment, and other products for government, defense, and commercial sectors.

companies.name: Lam Research
companies.description: Lam Research Corporation is an American supplier of wafer-fabrication equipment and services to the semiconductor industry. Its products are used in front-end wafer processing and back-end wafer-level packaging, including markets like microelectromechanical systems.

companies.name: Larsen & Toubro
companies.description: Larsen & Toubro Limited (L&T) is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai. It operates in industrial technology, heavy industry, engineering, construction, manufacturing, power, IT, defence, and financial services sectors.

companies.name: Leonardo
companies.description: Leonardo S.p.A. is an Italian multinational company specializing in aerospace, defence, and security. Headquartered in Rome, it has 180 sites worldwide and is the 12th largest defence contractor globally based on 2020 revenues.

companies.name: LG Energy Solution
companies.description: LG Energy Solution Ltd. is a battery company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It is one of the largest battery makers globally, producing batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage systems.

companies.name: Li Auto
companies.description: Li Auto Inc. is a Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Beijing with manufacturing facilities in Changzhou. Founded in 2015, it is known for producing electric vehicles with range extender petrol engines.

companies.name: Linde
companies.description: Linde plc is a global multinational chemical company and the world's largest industrial gas supplier by market share and revenue. Founded in 1879 in Germany, it is now headquartered in Woking, UK, and was formed in 2018 through a merger.

companies.name: Lloyds Banking
companies.description: Lloyds Bank plc is a major British retail and commercial bank with a significant presence across England and Wales. It is traditionally regarded as one of the "Big Four" clearing banks in the UK.

companies.name: Loblaw
companies.description: Loblaw Companies Limited is a Canadian retailer established in 1919. It operates corporate and franchise supermarkets under 22 banners, including pharmacies, banking, and apparel. Loblaw is the largest Canadian food retailer and is controlled by George Weston Limited.

companies.name: Localiza
companies.description: Localiza is a Brazilian car rental company founded in 1973 in Belo Horizonte. It is the largest car rental company in Latin America and one of the largest worldwide by fleet size and market capitalization.

companies.name: Lockheed Martin
companies.description: Lockheed Martin Corporation is an American defense and aerospace manufacturer headquartered in North Bethesda, Maryland. It was formed in 1995 by the merger of Lockheed Corporation and Martin Marietta.

companies.name: London Stock Exchange
companies.description: The London Stock Exchange is a global stock exchange based in the City of London, England, founded in 1801. It is one of the world's oldest continuously operating stock exchanges and is operated by the London Stock Exchange Group since 2007.

companies.name: Lonza
companies.description: Lonza Group AG is a Swiss multinational manufacturing company headquartered in Basel. It serves the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and nutrition sectors with product development and custom manufacturing services. The company has major facilities in Europe, North America, and South Asia.

companies.name: Lucid
companies.description: Lucid Group, Inc. is an American automotive and technology company headquartered in Newark, California. It manufactures electric vehicles and powertrain systems, producing models like the Lucid Air sedan and Lucid Gravity SUV. Lucid also supplies powertrain technology to other automakers.

companies.name: LVMH
companies.description: LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton SE is a French multinational holding company specializing in luxury goods, headquartered in Paris. It was formed in 1987 through the merger of Louis Vuitton and Moët Hennessy. In 2023, it became the first European company to surpass a $500 billion valuation.

companies.name: Macquarie
companies.description: Macquarie Group Limited, known as Macquarie Bank, is an Australian multinational investment banking and financial services group headquartered in Sydney. It operates across 34 markets and employs over 20,000 staff.

companies.name: Mainfreight
companies.description: Mainfreight Limited is a New Zealand logistics and transport company headquartered in Auckland. Founded in 1978, it is the largest logistics company in New Zealand and has been listed on the New Zealand Exchange since 1996.

companies.name: Marvell Technology
companies.description: Marvell Technology, Inc. is an American semiconductor company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. Founded in 1995, it develops and produces semiconductors and related technology. The company holds over 10,000 patents worldwide.

companies.name: Maybank
companies.description: Malayan Banking Berhad, known as Maybank, is a Malaysian universal bank operating primarily in Malaysia, Singapore, and Indonesia. It is recognized as Malaysia's most valuable bank brand and ranks among the top bank brands in ASEAN and globally.

companies.name: Mediatek
companies.description: MediaTek Inc. is a Taiwanese fabless semiconductor company that designs and markets semiconductor products. It provides chips for wireless communications, HDTV, mobile devices, navigation systems, multimedia products, and digital subscriber line services.

companies.name: Mediobanca
companies.description: Mediobanca S.p.A. is an Italian investment bank founded in 1946 to aid post-World War II industrial reconstruction. It operates internationally with offices in major cities including Milan, Frankfurt, London, and New York.

companies.name: Mega Financial
companies.description: Mega International Commercial Bank is the second largest bank in Taiwan by tier 1 capital and a subsidiary of Mega Financial Holding Company. It operates 108 branches in Taiwan and 39 overseas units and is the sole domestic US dollar/Euro settlement bank designated by the Bankers Association.

companies.name: MercadoLibre
companies.description: MercadoLibre, Inc. is an Argentine-origin company headquartered in Montevideo, Uruguay, operating online marketplaces for e-commerce and auctions. It is the most popular e-commerce site in Latin America by number of visitors as of 2016.

companies.name: Mercedes-Benz
companies.description: Mercedes-Benz is a German luxury automotive brand founded in 1926 and based in Stuttgart, Germany. It manufactures luxury vehicles and light commercial vehicles under the Mercedes-Benz name. Heavy commercial vehicle production was separated into Daimler Truck in 2019.

companies.name: Merck &
companies.description: Merck & Co., Inc. is an American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Rahway, New Jersey. It operates as Merck Sharp & Dohme outside the US and Canada and ranks fifth among the largest biomedical companies by revenue.

companies.name: Merck Kgaa
companies.description: The Merck Group is a German multinational science and technology company headquartered in Darmstadt. Founded in 1668, it is the world's oldest operating chemical and pharmaceutical company and operates in healthcare, life sciences, and electronics sectors.

companies.name: Meridian Energy
companies.description: Meridian Energy Limited is a New Zealand electricity generator and retailer. It generates the largest proportion of New Zealand's electricity and holds the fourth largest retail market share by customers as of 2015.

companies.name: Meta Platforms
companies.description: Meta Platforms, Inc. is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Menlo Park, California. It owns and operates major social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads. Advertising accounts for the vast majority of its revenue.

companies.name: MetLife
companies.description: MetLife, Inc. is a holding corporation for Metropolitan Life Insurance Company and its affiliates. Based in the United States, it is one of the largest global providers of insurance, annuities, and employee benefit programs, serving around 90 million customers in over 60 countries. The company was founded in 1868.

companies.name: Microchip Technology
companies.description: Microchip Technology Incorporated is an American publicly traded semiconductor company. It manufactures microcontrollers, microprocessors, integrated circuits, and flash memory. The company operates in the electronics industry.

companies.name: Micron Technology
companies.description: Micron Technology, Inc. is an American multinational semiconductor company founded in 1978 in Boise, Idaho. It manufactures computer memory and data storage products such as DRAM, flash memory, High Bandwidth Memory, and solid-state drives. It is the only major American computer memory manufacturer.

companies.name: Midea
companies.description: Midea Group is a Chinese electrical appliance manufacturer headquartered in Beijiao town, Shunde District, Foshan, Guangdong. It produces a wide range of appliances including lighting, water appliances, kitchen and refrigeration products. Midea is the largest microwave oven manufacturer and was reportedly the world's largest producer of industrial robots and appliances in 2017.

companies.name: Mitsui &
companies.description: Mitsui & Co., Ltd. is a Japanese general trading company and a core member of the Mitsui Group. It has been among the largest of the five major sogo shosha trading companies in Japan by revenue and profits for much of the post-war period.

companies.name: Mobis
companies.description: Hyundai Mobis Company Limited is a South Korean public car parts company and a member of Hyundai Motor Group. Founded in 1977, it serves as the parts and service arm for Hyundai Motor Company, Genesis Motors, and Kia Motors. As of 2025, it was the world's sixth largest automotive supplier.

companies.name: Mol
companies.description: MOL Plc., also known as MOL Group, is a Hungarian multinational oil and gas company headquartered in Budapest. It includes Croatian and Slovak former state-owned companies INA and Slovnaft. MOL is Hungary's second most profitable enterprise and was ranked 402 on the Fortune Global 500 list in 2013.

companies.name: Moncler
companies.description: Moncler S.p.A. is an Italian luxury fashion brand headquartered in Milan, Italy. It specializes in ready-to-wear outerwear and features distinctive branding elements such as the cockerel, "M" monogram, and crossed skis. The company is known for its unique felt appliqué badge and cartoon duck mascot.

companies.name: Moneta Money Bank
companies.description: Moneta Money Bank, a.s., also known as Moneta Bank, is a Czech bank headquartered in Prague. It was previously owned by General Electric and became publicly traded in 2016. Its shares are listed on the Prague Stock Exchange and are part of the PX Index.

companies.name: Mowi
companies.description: Mowi ASA is a Norwegian seafood company focused on fish farming, primarily salmon, with operations in Norway, Scotland, Canada, the Faroe Islands, Ireland, and Chile. It is the world's largest company in the salmon and trout market, holding a 25 to 30% share globally. Mowi also operates a value-added processing unit for seafood products.

companies.name: MTN
companies.description: MTN Group Limited is a South African multinational corporation and mobile telecommunications provider headquartered in Johannesburg. It is among the largest mobile network operators globally and the largest in Africa.

companies.name: Naspers
companies.description: Naspers Limited is a South African multinational holding company headquartered in Cape Town. It operates in the internet, technology, and multimedia sectors.

companies.name: National Australia Bank
companies.description: National Australia Bank Limited is one of the four largest financial institutions in Australia by market capitalization, earnings, and customers. It was ranked as the world's 21st-largest bank by market capitalization and 52nd-largest by total assets in 2019.

companies.name: National Bank of Greece
companies.description: The National Bank of Greece is a banking and financial services company headquartered in Athens, Greece. Founded in 1841 as the country's first financial institution, it remains one of Greece's four dominant banks. It offers a range of services including banking, brokerage, insurance, asset management, and shipping finance.

companies.name: The National Bank Of Kuwait Kwd
companies.legal_name: The National Bank Of Kuwait Kwd

listings.name: The National Bank Of Kuwait Kwd

companies.name: National Grid
companies.description: National Grid plc is a British multinational electricity transmission company headquartered in London, England. It operates electricity transmission networks in Great Britain and the Northeastern United States, where it also produces and supplies electricity and gas to customers in New York and Massachusetts.

companies.name: Naver
companies.description: Naver is a South Korean online platform operated by Naver Corporation. Its products include a search engine, email hosting, blogs, maps, and mobile payment services.

companies.name: Neste
companies.description: Neste Oyj is an oil refining and marketing company based in Espoo, Finland. It produces, refines, and markets oil products, provides engineering services, and licenses production technologies. Neste operates in 14 countries.

companies.name: Nestlé
companies.description: Nestlé S.A. is a Swiss multinational food and drink processing conglomerate headquartered in Vevey, Switzerland. It has been the largest publicly held food company in the world since 2014. The company was ranked 50th in the Forbes Global 2000 in 2023.

companies.name: Netflix
companies.description: Netflix, Inc. is an American media company based in Los Gatos, California. It operates a subscription video on-demand service featuring acquired and original programming, as well as licensed third-party content. Netflix is the first streaming media company to be a member of the Motion Picture Association.

companies.name: Newmont
companies.description: Newmont Corporation is an American gold mining company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It is the world's largest gold mining corporation and owns mines in multiple countries including the US, Canada, and Australia. Newmont also mines copper, silver, zinc, and lead.

companies.name: NextEra Energy
companies.description: NextEra Energy, Inc. is an American energy company and the world's largest electric utility holding company by market capitalization. It operates throughout the US and Canada with subsidiaries including Florida Power & Light and NextEra Energy Resources. The company has a generating capacity of 73 gigawatts.

companies.name: Nintendo
companies.description: Nintendo Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational video game company headquartered in Kyoto. It develops, publishes, and manufactures video games and video game consoles.

companies.name: NIO
companies.description: Nio Inc. is a Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Shanghai. Founded in 2014 and renamed in 2016, it designs and sells electric vehicles including sedans and SUVs. The company has expanded into chip development, smartphones, and power solutions.

companies.name: Nn
companies.description: NN Group N.V. is a Dutch parent company of NN Investment Partners and Nationale-Nederlanden, one of the largest insurance and asset management companies in the Netherlands. It is headquartered in The Hague with offices in Rotterdam and Ede. NN mainly relies on independent intermediaries for selling insurance.

companies.name: Nokia
companies.description: Nokia Corporation is a Finnish multinational telecommunications, information technology, and consumer electronics company headquartered in Espoo, Finland. Established originally as a pulp mill in 1865, Nokia operates in over 100 countries and is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki and the New York Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Nordea Bank Abp
companies.description: Nordea Bank Abp is a Nordic financial services group headquartered in Helsinki, Finland. It operates primarily in northern Europe and has exited markets such as Poland, the Baltics, and Russia. Nordea is listed on Nasdaq Nordic exchanges and trades American Depository Receipts in the US.

companies.name: Norsk Hydro
companies.description: Norsk Hydro ASA is a Norwegian aluminium and renewable energy company headquartered in Oslo. It is one of the largest aluminium companies worldwide with operations in about 50 countries. The Norwegian state owns a significant portion of the company through the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Fisheries.

companies.name: Northrop Grumman
companies.description: Northrop Grumman Corporation is an American aerospace and defense company based in West Falls Church, Virginia. It designs and manufactures systems for aeronautics, defense, missions, and space. The company is the fifth-largest contractor of the U.S. federal government.

companies.name: Nos, Sgps
companies.description: NOS, SGPS S.A. is a Portuguese telecommunications and media company providing mobile and fixed telephony, cable and satellite television, and internet services. It was formed in 2013 from the merger of Zon Multimédia and Sonae's Optimus Telecommunications. The company operates primarily in Portugal.

companies.name: Novartis
companies.description: Novartis AG is a Swiss multinational pharmaceutical corporation headquartered in Basel, Switzerland. It is one of the largest pharmaceutical companies globally and was ranked eighth largest by revenue in 2024.

companies.name: Novo Nordisk
companies.description: Novo Nordisk A/S, known as Novo, is a Danish multinational pharmaceutical company. It primarily manufactures and markets obesity and diabetes medications and devices. The company was created in 1989 through a merger of two Danish pharmaceutical companies dating back to the 1920s.

companies.name: Novonesis (Novozymes
companies.description: Novonesis was formed in 2024 through the merger of Danish biotechnology company Novozymes A/S and Chr. Hansen. Novozymes is known as a biotechnology company based in Denmark.

companies.name: Ntt
companies.description: NTT, Inc. is a Japanese telecommunications holding company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It is among the largest telecommunications companies globally by revenue and was ranked 128th in the Fortune Global 500 in 2026. NTT was once the world's largest company by market capitalization in the late 1980s.

companies.name: Nutrien
companies.description: Nutrien is a Canadian fertilizer company headquartered in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. It is the largest producer of potash and the second largest producer of nitrogen fertilizer worldwide. The company was formed in 2018 through the merger of PotashCorp and Agrium.

companies.name: NVIDIA
companies.description: Nvidia Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It develops graphics processing units, systems on chips, and APIs for gaming, data science, AI hardware, and automotive applications. Founded in 1993, Nvidia is among the largest companies by market capitalization.

companies.name: NXP Semiconductors
companies.description: NXP Semiconductors N.V. is a Dutch multinational semiconductor manufacturing and design company headquartered in Eindhoven, Netherlands. It is the second-largest European semiconductor design and manufacturing company by market capitalization as of 2024. The company serves customers including Apple, Dell, Ericsson, and Samsung.

companies.name: OCBC Bank
companies.description: Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation Limited (OCBC) is a Singaporean multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered at the OCBC Centre. It is the second largest bank in Southeast Asia by assets as of 2024. OCBC operates over 400 branches and representative offices in 19 countries including Malaysia, Indonesia, China, Hong Kong, and Macau.

companies.name: Occidental Petroleum
companies.description: Occidental Petroleum Corporation is an American company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration in the United States and the Middle East. It is incorporated under Delaware General Corporation Law and headquartered in Houston, Texas.

companies.name: OMV
companies.description: OMV is the major integrated oil and gas company in Austria, formerly known as Österreichische Mineralölverwaltung Aktiengesellschaft. Its business activities include fuels and feedstock, petrochemicals, and energy.

companies.name: Oracle
companies.description: Oracle Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Austin, Texas. Founded in 1977 in Santa Clara, California, it is among the 50 largest companies in the world by market capitalization as of 2026.

companies.name: Orange
companies.description: Orange S.A. is a French multinational telecommunications corporation founded in 1988. It is headquartered in Issy-les-Moulineaux, near Paris, France.

companies.name: Orbia Advance
companies.description: Orbia is a Mexican company providing specialty products and methodologies in agriculture, building and infrastructure, fluorinated solutions, polymer solutions, and data communications. Founded in 1953, it is headquartered in Mexico City.

companies.name: Orkla
companies.description: Orkla ASA is a Norwegian conglomerate operating in Europe, Asia, and the US. It operates in branded consumer goods, aluminium products, and financial investment sectors, with its head office in Oslo, Norway.

companies.name: Orlen
companies.description: Orlen SA is a Polish multinational oil refiner, petrol retailer, and natural gas trader headquartered in Płock, Poland. Its subsidiaries include major oil and gas companies in Czechia and Lithuania, Unipetrol and Orlen Lietuva.

companies.name: Otp
companies.description: OTP Bank Group is the largest commercial bank in Hungary and a major independent financial service provider in Central and Eastern Europe. It offers banking services to private individuals and corporate clients and operates subsidiaries in insurance, real estate, and asset management. The group has a presence in 10 countries beyond Hungary.

companies.name: Pampa Energía
companies.description: Pampa Energía S.A. is Argentina's largest independent energy company, involved in electricity and oil and gas sectors. Founded in 2005, it is headquartered in Buenos Aires. The company participates across the energy value chain in Argentina.

companies.name: Pandora
companies.description: Pandora A/S is a Danish jewelry manufacturer and retailer founded in 1982 by Per Enevoldsen. It began as a family-run jewelry shop in Copenhagen. The company is known for its jewelry products.

companies.name: Partners
companies.description: Partners Group Holding AG is a Swiss global private equity firm managing assets across private equity, infrastructure, real estate, private debt, and royalties. It is headquartered in Switzerland and manages substantial assets worldwide.

companies.name: PepsiCo
companies.description: PepsiCo, Inc. is an American multinational food and beverage corporation headquartered in Harrison, New York. Formed in 1965 by merging Pepsi-Cola Company and Frito-Lay, it has expanded to include brands like Tropicana and Gatorade. PepsiCo oversees manufacturing, distribution, and marketing of its products.

companies.name: Petrobras
companies.description: Petróleo Brasileiro S.A., known as Petrobras, is a Brazilian majority state-owned multinational corporation in the petroleum industry. It is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. The company's name translates to Brazilian Petroleum Corporation.

companies.name: Petrochina
companies.description: PetroChina Company Limited is a Chinese oil and gas company and the listed arm of state-owned China National Petroleum Corporation. Headquartered in Beijing, it is Asia's largest oil and gas producer. PetroChina is traded in Hong Kong and New York and is part of the SSE 50 Index.

companies.name: Pfizer
companies.description: Pfizer Inc. is an American multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology corporation headquartered in Manhattan, New York City. Founded in 1849 by Charles Pfizer and Charles F. Erhart, it is one of North America's oldest pharmaceutical companies.

companies.name: Ping An Insurance(Group)Co.Of C
companies.description: Ping An Insurance (Group) Company of China, Ltd. is a Chinese financial services holding company headquartered in Shenzhen. Founded in 1988, its subsidiaries provide insurance, banking, asset management, and other financial services. The name "Ping An" means "safe and well."

companies.name: Piraeus Bank
companies.description: Piraeus Bank is a Greek multinational financial services company headquartered in Athens, Greece. It has been listed on Euronext Athens since January 1918. The bank operates in the financial services sector.

companies.name: PKO Bank Polski
companies.description: PKO Bank Polski is a multinational banking and financial services company headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. It is the largest universal bank in Poland and one of the largest financial institutions in Central and Eastern Europe. The bank's history dates back to 1919.

companies.name: Porsche
companies.description: Porsche is a German automobile manufacturer headquartered in Stuttgart, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. It specializes in luxury, high-performance sports cars, SUVs, and sedans. The company is owned by Volkswagen AG and includes models such as the 911 and Taycan.

companies.name: Progressive
companies.description: The Progressive Corporation is an American insurance company headquartered in Mayfield, Ohio. Founded in 1937, it insures various types of vehicles and also provides home, life, pet, and other insurance through select companies.

companies.name: Prologis
companies.description: Prologis, Inc. is a real estate investment trust headquartered in San Francisco, California, investing in logistics facilities. Formed in 2011 through a merger, it became the largest industrial real estate company globally. It operates thousands of buildings across 20 countries.

companies.name: Prosus
companies.description: Prosus N.V. is a Dutch investment group that invests and operates across sectors and markets with long-term growth potential. It is among the largest technology investors in the world. The company is based in the Netherlands.

companies.name: Prudential Financial
companies.description: Prudential Financial, Inc. is an American financial services company offering insurance, retirement planning, and investment management across the US and more than 40 countries. It was the largest insurance provider in the US in 2019 and is included in the Fortune Global 500.

companies.name: Prysmian
companies.description: Prysmian S.p.A. is a multinational company headquartered in Bicocca, Milan, Italy, specializing in electrical and optical cables for digital connections. It operates 109 plants worldwide, including locations in North America, LATAM, and EMEA.

companies.name: PTT
companies.description: PTT Public Company Limited is a Thai state-owned petroleum and natural gas company listed on the SET. It operates extensive submarine gas pipelines, LPG terminals, and is involved in electricity generation, petrochemicals, oil and gas exploration, and gasoline retailing. The company also owns Café Amazon, a popular coffee chain in Southeast Asia.

companies.name: Public Bank
companies.description: Public Bank Berhad is a bank based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It offers financial services within Malaysia and across the Asia-Pacific region.

companies.name: Public Service Enterprise
companies.description: The Public Service Enterprise Group, Inc. (PSEG) is a publicly traded energy company headquartered in Newark, New Jersey. Founded in 1985 with roots dating back to 1903, it operates in the energy sector.

companies.name: Public Storage
companies.description: Public Storage is a real estate investment trust headquartered in Frisco, Texas, specializing in self-storage facilities. It is the largest self-storage brand in the US, owning about 9% of the country's self-storage space and operating thousands of facilities.

companies.name: Qualcomm
companies.description: Qualcomm Incorporated is an American multinational technology company headquartered in San Diego, California. It develops technologies for global communications and computing, including mobile processors and AI chips, and holds essential patents for mobile communication standards like 5G and 4G.

companies.name: Randstad
companies.description: Randstad NV is a Dutch multinational human resource consulting firm headquartered in Diemen, Netherlands. Founded in 1960, it is the world's largest staffing and recruitment company by revenue, operating in 39 markets with approximately 38,000 employees.

companies.name: Realty Income
companies.description: Realty Income Corporation is a real estate investment trust headquartered in San Diego, California. It invests in free-standing, single-tenant commercial properties across the US, UK, and other European countries, operating under NNN leases.

companies.name: Recruit
companies.description: Recruit Holdings Co., Ltd. is an HR Tech holding company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It operates in the human resources technology sector.

companies.name: Reliance Industries
companies.description: Reliance Industries Limited is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai. It operates in sectors including energy, petrochemicals, natural gas, retail, entertainment, telecommunications, mass media, and textiles. It is the largest public company in India by market capitalization and revenue.

companies.name: Relx
companies.description: RELX plc is a British multinational information and publishing company headquartered in London, England. It provides scientific, technical, medical, and legal information and event organization services. The company was formed in 1993 through the merger of Reed International and Elsevier.

companies.name: Repsol,
companies.description: Repsol S.A. is a Spanish multinational energy and petrochemical company based in Madrid. It engages in worldwide upstream and downstream activities. In 2022, it was ranked as the 320th-largest public company globally by Forbes.

companies.name: Rheinmetall
companies.description: Rheinmetall AG is a German arms manufacturer headquartered in Düsseldorf. It is the largest German and fifth-largest European arms manufacturer, producing armored vehicles, munitions, air defense systems, and warships. The company also produces reconnaissance radar satellites and components for the F-35 fighter jet.

companies.name: Richemont
companies.description: Compagnie Financière Richemont SA is a Switzerland-based luxury goods holding company founded in 1988. It produces and sells jewellery, watches, leather goods, pens, firearms, clothing, and accessories through its subsidiaries. Richemont is publicly traded on the SIX Swiss Exchange and the JSE.

companies.name: Rio Tinto
companies.description: Rio Tinto Group is a British–Australian multinational mining company headquartered in London and Melbourne. Founded in 1873, it has grown through mergers and acquisitions and is a major producer of commodities such as copper, iron ore, aluminium, and lithium.

companies.name: Rio Tinto
companies.description: Rio Tinto Group is a British–Australian multinational mining company headquartered in London and Melbourne. Founded in 1873, it has grown through mergers and acquisitions and is a major producer of commodities such as copper, iron ore, aluminium, and lithium.

companies.name: Rivian Automotive
companies.description: Rivian Automotive, Inc. is an American electric vehicle manufacturer and automotive technology company founded in 2009. It produces electric SUVs, pickup trucks, and delivery vans, including the Rivian EDV sold to Amazon. The company operates the Rivian Adventure Network, a DC fast charging network in the US.

companies.name: Roche
companies.description: F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, known as Roche, is a Swiss multinational healthcare holding company headquartered in Basel. It operates in Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics divisions and is the fifth-largest pharmaceutical company globally by revenue. Roche is a leading provider of cancer treatments worldwide.

companies.name: Rolls-Royce
companies.description: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars Limited is a British luxury automobile maker and a wholly owned subsidiary of BMW AG since 2003. Its administrative and production headquarters are located at the Goodwood plant in West Sussex, England. The company exclusively manufactures Rolls-Royce-badged motor cars.

companies.name: Royal Bank of Canada
companies.description: The Royal Bank of Canada is a Canadian multinational financial services company and the largest bank in Canada by market capitalization. Founded in 1864 in Halifax, Nova Scotia, it serves over 19 million clients worldwide. RBC is recognized as a global systemically important bank by the Financial Stability Board.

companies.name: RTX
companies.description: RTX Corporation is an American multinational aerospace and defense conglomerate headquartered in Arlington, Virginia. It manufactures aircraft engines, avionics, missiles, satellites, and drones, and is a major military contractor primarily serving the U.S. government. The company was formerly known as Raytheon Technologies Corporation.

companies.name: Ryanair
companies.description: Ryanair is an Irish ultra-low-cost airline headquartered in Swords, County Dublin, Ireland. It is the largest airline in Europe by scheduled passengers, fleet size, and total flights, and the largest airline globally by international passengers carried. Ryanair is known for being the cheapest airline operating in Europe.

companies.name: SABIC
companies.description: Saudi Basic Industries Corporation (SABIC) is a Saudi chemical manufacturing company active in petrochemicals, chemicals, industrial polymers, and fertilizers. Seventy percent of its shares are owned by Saudi Aramco. SABIC is the second largest public company in the Middle East and Saudi Arabia as listed on Tadawul.

companies.name: Safran
companies.description: Safran S.A. is a French multinational aerospace, defense, and security corporation headquartered in Paris. It designs and manufactures commercial and military aircraft engines, launch vehicle propulsion systems, and various aerospace and military equipment. Safran operates in both the aerospace and defense sectors.

companies.name: Salesforce
companies.description: Salesforce, Inc. is an American software company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It develops customer relationship management (CRM) software marketed through a subscription business model. Salesforce is a component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average and the S&P 500.

companies.name: Salmar
companies.description: SalMar ASA is a Norwegian fish farming company and one of the world's largest producers of farmed salmon. It operates marine-phase farming, broodfish and smolt production, processing, and sales, holding 100 licenses for Atlantic salmon production in Norway. The company is based in Frøya Municipality and listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Sampo
companies.description: Sampo Group is a property and casualty insurance group operating in the Nordics, Baltics, and the UK. It operates in four segments: Private in the Nordics and UK, and Commercial and Industrial in the Nordics. The company focuses on insurance services within these regions.

companies.name: Samsung Electronics
companies.description: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational consumer electronics and semiconductor corporation headquartered in Suwon, South Korea. It is the flagship listed company of the Samsung chaebol and a major supplier of memory chips, displays, smartphones, and home appliances.

companies.name: Sandvik
companies.description: Sandvik AB is a Swedish multinational engineering company specializing in products and services for mining, rock excavation, drilling, processing, metal cutting, and machining. Founded in 1862 in Gävleborg County, Sweden, it operates globally with sales in around 150 countries.

companies.name: Sanlam
companies.description: Sanlam Limited is a South African financial services group headquartered in Bellville, Cape Town. It is one of the largest insurance companies in Africa and is listed on the Johannesburg, Namibian, and A2X stock exchanges.

companies.name: Sanofi
companies.description: Sanofi S.A. is a French multinational pharmaceutical and healthcare company headquartered in Paris. Established in 1973, it underwent several mergers and name changes before reverting to Sanofi in 2011. It is listed on Euronext Paris and Nasdaq and is part of the Euro Stoxx 50 index.

companies.name: SAP
companies.description: SAP SE is a German multinational software company based in Walldorf, Baden-Württemberg. It is the world's largest vendor of enterprise software and was the largest European company by market capitalization as of June 2025.

companies.name: Sasol
companies.description: Sasol Limited is an integrated energy and chemical company based in Sandton, South Africa. It operates in the energy and chemical sectors.

companies.name: Saudi Aramco
companies.description: Saudi Aramco, officially the Saudi Arabian Oil Company, is a majority state-owned petroleum and natural gas company headquartered in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia. It holds the world's largest proven crude oil reserves and largest daily oil production.

companies.name: Savola
companies.description: The Savola Group is a Saudi Arabian industrial company supplying edible oils, sugar, fresh dairy products, and fast food restaurants across Saudi Arabia, the Middle East, North Africa, and Turkey. It also owns the largest grocery retail chain in the Middle East, Panda Retail Company.

companies.name: Schneider Electric
companies.description: Schneider Electric SE is a French multinational corporation specializing in energy technology. It focuses on electrification, automation, and digitalization solutions for industry and homes.

companies.name: Sempra
companies.description: Sempra is a North American public utility holding company based in San Diego, California. It serves nearly 40 million consumers with electric and natural gas infrastructure through subsidiaries like SoCalGas and San Diego Gas & Electric.

companies.name: Shell
companies.description: Shell plc is a British multinational oil and gas company headquartered in London, England. It is the largest investor-owned oil company in Europe and among the world's largest companies overall, with listings on the London Stock Exchange, Euronext Amsterdam, and NYSE.

companies.name: Sherwin-Williams
companies.description: Sherwin-Williams is an American company based in Cleveland, Ohio, specializing in paints and coatings. It manufactures, distributes, and sells paints, coatings, floor coverings, and related products. The company operates in over 120 countries and is the largest coatings company in the world by revenue.

companies.name: Shin-Etsu Chemical
companies.description: Shin-Etsu Chemical Co., Ltd. is the largest chemical company in Japan. It holds the largest global market share for polyvinyl chloride, semiconductor silicon, and photomask substrates. The company is a major player in the chemical industry.

companies.name: Shopify
companies.description: Shopify Inc. is a Canadian multinational e-commerce company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario. It operates a cloud e-commerce management platform for retail point-of-sale systems and serves over five million customers. Major customers include Tesla, LVMH, Nestlé, and PepsiCo.

companies.name: Shoprite
companies.description: Shoprite is Africa's largest supermarket retailer and one of the largest retail companies globally. Founded in 1979, the company is headquartered in Cape Town, South Africa. It operates extensively across the African continent.

companies.name: Siemens
companies.description: Siemens AG is a German multinational company focused on industrial automation, building automation, rail transport, and health technology. It is the largest engineering company in Europe and a global market leader in industrial AI, automation, and industrial software.

companies.name: Sika
companies.description: Sika AG is a Swiss multinational specialty chemical company headquartered in Baar, Switzerland. It supplies products and systems for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protecting to the building and motor vehicle industries. The company operates over 400 factories worldwide.

companies.name: Simon Property
companies.hq: Simon Property Group Headquarters, United States
companies.description: Simon Property Group, Inc. is an American real estate investment trust headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. It invests in shopping malls, outlet centers, and community/lifestyle centers. It is the largest owner of shopping malls in the United States with interests in 235 properties.

companies.name: Singapore Airlines
companies.description: Singapore Airlines Limited is the flag carrier of Singapore with its hub at Changi Airport. It operates a diverse fleet of 160 Airbus and Boeing passenger and freighter aircraft. The airline was the launch customer for the Airbus A380 and Boeing 787-10 and is a member of Star Alliance since 2000.

companies.name: Singtel
companies.description: Singapore Telecommunications Limited, trading as Singtel, is a Singaporean telecommunications conglomerate. It is Singapore's principal fixed-line operator and one of the four major mobile network operators in the country.

companies.name: SK hynix
companies.description: SK Hynix Inc. is a South Korean semiconductor company that manufactures dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) and flash memory chips. It is one of the world's largest semiconductor vendors and part of the "Big Three" memory manufacturers alongside Samsung Electronics and Micron.

companies.name: SLB
companies.description: SLB, formerly Schlumberger, is a multinational oilfield services company founded in France in 1926. It is incorporated in Willemstad, Curaçao, with executive offices in Paris, Houston, London, and The Hague. SLB is the world's largest offshore drilling company and contractor by revenue as of 2022.

companies.name: Smc
companies.description: SMC Corporation is a Japanese company specializing in pneumatic control engineering for industrial automation. Founded in 1959, it develops control systems like valves and actuators. Its headquarters are in Tokyo, with production and technical facilities worldwide including the US, Europe, China, and Singapore.

companies.name: Snam
companies.description: Snam S.p.A. is Italy's natural gas transmission system operator managing the country's high-pressure pipeline network. It transports gas to distributors, industry, and power plants, and is also active in storage, LNG, and hydrogen sectors.

companies.name: SoftBank
companies.description: SoftBank Group Corp. is a Japanese multinational investment holding company headquartered in Tokyo. It focuses on investment management primarily in technology companies across various markets. Its Vision Fund is the world's largest technology-focused venture capital fund with over $100 billion in capital at inception.

companies.name: Solvay
companies.description: Solvay is a Belgian-French multinational chemical company established in 1863 with headquarters in Brussels, Belgium. Since 2023, after a demerger creating Syensqo, Solvay specializes in essential chemistry and operates in 40 countries with over 9,000 employees.

companies.name: Southern
companies.description: Southern Company is an American gas and electric utility holding company based in the Southern United States. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, it serves 9 million customers across six states through its subsidiaries. It is the second largest utility company in the U.S. by customer base as of 2021.

companies.name: Spark New Zealand
companies.description: Spark New Zealand Limited is a telecommunications and digital services company based in New Zealand. It provides fixed-line, mobile, broadband, and digital services to consumers, businesses, and government. Formerly Telecom New Zealand, it was rebranded to Spark in 2014 and has operated publicly since 1990.

companies.name: Sse
companies.description: SSE plc is a British multinational electricity company headquartered in Perth, Scotland. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

companies.name: Standard Bank
companies.description: Standard Bank is the largest bank in Africa and the continent's largest lender by assets. It operates primarily in South Africa and held a total of R3.8 trillion in assets in 2026. The bank plays a significant role in Africa's financial sector.

companies.name: State Bank Of India
companies.description: The State Bank of India (SBI) is an Indian multinational public sector bank headquartered in Mumbai. It is the largest bank in India by assets and deposits and has a customer base of 53 crore as of July 2026. SBI is also one of the largest employers in India.

companies.name: Stellantis
companies.description: Stellantis N.V. is a multinational automotive manufacturing corporation headquartered in Hoofddorp, Netherlands. Formed in 2021 through the merger of PSA Group and Fiat Chrysler Automobiles, it has a CEO operating from Auburn Hills, Michigan, United States. Stellantis is a major player in the global automotive industry.

companies.name: STMicroelectronics
companies.description: STMicroelectronics NV is a European multinational semiconductor contract manufacturing and design company. Incorporated in the Netherlands and headquartered in Plan-les-Ouates, Switzerland, it is the largest semiconductor company in Europe. It produces a wide range of microelectronics including STM8 and STM32 microcontrollers.

companies.name: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial
companies.description: Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation is a Japanese multinational banking financial services institution owned by Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group. It is headquartered in Marunouchi, Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan, in the same building as its parent group. The bank is a key part of Japan's financial sector.

companies.name: Suncor Energy
companies.description: Suncor Energy Inc. is a Canadian integrated energy company based in Calgary, Alberta. It specializes in producing synthetic crude from oil sands. In 2026, it was ranked as the 256th-largest public company in the world by Forbes Global 2000.

companies.name: Swedbank
companies.description: Swedbank AB is a Swedish multinational banking group headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. It operates mainly in the Nordic and Baltic regions, offering retail banking, asset management, and other financial services. Swedbank has extensive retail operations in Sweden, Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania.

companies.name: Swiss Re
companies.description: Swiss Re Ltd is a Swiss reinsurance company founded in 1863 and headquartered in Zürich, Switzerland. It is one of the world's largest reinsurers by gross premiums written, operating through around 80 offices in 29 countries. Swiss Re is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange.

companies.name: Symrise
companies.description: Symrise AG is a German chemicals company specializing in cosmetic ingredients, flavours, and fragrances. It is a member of the European Flavour Association and was ranked 4th in FoodTalks' Global Top 50 Food Flavours and Fragrances Companies list in 2021. Its major competitors include Givaudan and Döhler.

companies.name: Taiwan Semiconductor
companies.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Company Limited is a Taiwanese manufacturer of semiconductors and electronic components serving industries such as automotive, communications, and consumer goods. Headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, it operates service centers in China, the US, Germany, and Japan. Its subsidiary specializes in barcode and RFID printers.

companies.name: Takeda Pharmaceutical
companies.description: Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited is a Japanese multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Osaka. It is the largest pharmaceutical company in Japan and focuses on oncology, rare diseases, neuroscience, gastroenterology, plasma-derived therapies, and vaccines. The company has offices in Tokyo and was ranked among the 100 best companies to work for in the US in 2012.

companies.name: Telenor
companies.description: Telenor ASA is a Norwegian majority state-owned multinational telecommunications company headquartered near Oslo. It operates worldwide with a focus on Scandinavia and Asia, owning networks in eight countries. The company also has broadband, TV distribution operations in four Nordic countries, and a research line for machine-to-machine technology.

companies.name: Telia
companies.description: Telia Company AB is a Swedish multinational telecommunications company and mobile network operator. It operates in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. The company provides telecommunications services across these Nordic and Baltic countries.

companies.name: Telkom Indonesia
companies.description: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk is an Indonesian multinational telecommunications conglomerate headquartered in Bandung with operational headquarters in Jakarta. It is listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange and the New York Stock Exchange, and the Indonesian government owns over half of its shares.

companies.name: Telstra Fpo [Tls]
companies.description: Telstra Group Limited is an Australian telecommunications company that builds and operates networks and markets related products and services. It is Australia's largest telecommunications company by market share and is a member of the S&P/ASX 20 stock index.

companies.name: Tenaga
companies.description: Tenaga Nasional Berhad is a Malaysian multinational electricity company and the primary electric utility in Peninsular Malaysia. It is the largest publicly listed power company in Southeast Asia and serves over 10 million customers in Peninsular Malaysia and additional customers in Sabah and Labuan.

companies.name: Tencent
companies.description: Tencent is a Chinese multinational technology conglomerate headquartered in Shenzhen. It is one of the highest grossing multimedia companies globally and the largest video game company by equity investments. Its stock-market-listed entity, Tencent Holdings Ltd, is incorporated in the Cayman Islands.

companies.name: TeraWulf
companies.description: TeraWulf Inc. is an American bitcoin mining company founded in 2021. It operates mining facilities in New York and Pennsylvania and is publicly listed on Nasdaq under the ticker WULF.

companies.name: Terna
companies.description: Terna S.p.A. is a transmission system operator based in Rome, Italy. It manages the Italian transmission grid and operates in Peru and the USA through its subsidiaries. Terna is the leading independent grid operator in Europe and is listed on the Borsa Italiana.

companies.name: Ternium Argentina
companies.description: Ternium S.A. is a manufacturer of flat and long steel products with production centers in several countries including Argentina and the United States. It owns a majority interest in Usiminas of Brazil and has a significant annual production capacity.

companies.name: Tesco
companies.description: Tesco PLC is a British multinational groceries and general merchandise retailer headquartered in Welwyn Garden City, England. Founded in 1919, it is the market leader of groceries in the UK and operates stores in several European countries.

companies.name: Teva Pharmaceutical
companies.description: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. is an Israeli multinational pharmaceutical company specializing primarily in generic drugs. It also engages in branded drugs, active pharmaceutical ingredients, contract manufacturing, and out-licensing.

companies.name: Texas Instruments
companies.description: Texas Instruments Incorporated is an American multinational semiconductor company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It focuses on analog chips and embedded processors and also produces digital light processing technology and education products.

companies.name: Thales
companies.description: Thales S.A., trading as Thales Group, is a French multinational aerospace and defence corporation specializing in electronics. It designs and manufactures aerospace and military systems and operates in cybersecurity. The company is headquartered in Paris and listed on Euronext Paris.

companies.name: Thermo Fisher Scientific
companies.description: Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is an American life science and clinical research company based in Waltham, Massachusetts. It supplies analytical instruments, clinical development solutions, specialty diagnostics, and biotechnology services globally. The company was formed in 2006 through the merger of Thermo Electron and Fisher Scientific and has acquired several other companies since.

companies.name: Tokio Marine
companies.description: Tokio Marine Holdings, Inc. is a multinational insurance holding company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It is the largest property and casualty insurance group in Japan by revenue and employs 39,000 people across 38 countries. Tokio Marine is the parent company of the Tokio Marine Group.

companies.name: Tokyo Electron
companies.description: Tokyo Electron Limited is a Japanese electronics and semiconductor company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Founded in 1963, it supplies equipment for manufacturing integrated circuits, flat panel displays, and photovoltaic cells. It is the largest manufacturer of IC and FPD production equipment as of 2011.

companies.name: Toronto-Dominion Bank
companies.description: Toronto-Dominion Bank, known as TD Bank Group, is a Canadian multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. It was created in 1955 through the merger of the Bank of Toronto and the Dominion Bank. TD is one of the Big Five banks of Canada.

companies.name: TotalEnergies
companies.description: TotalEnergies SE is a French multinational integrated energy and petroleum company founded in 1924. It is one of the seven supermajor oil companies and operates across the entire oil and gas chain including exploration, production, refining, and trading. The company is also a large-scale chemicals manufacturer.

companies.name: Toyota Motor
companies.description: Toyota Motor Corporation is a Japanese multinational automotive manufacturer headquartered in Toyota City, Aichi, Japan. Founded in 1937, it is the largest automobile manufacturer in the world by production volume. Toyota produces about 10 million vehicles annually.

companies.name: TransDigm
companies.description: TransDigm Group Incorporated is an American aerospace manufacturing company headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio. Founded in 1993, it develops and manufactures engineered aerospace components. The company expanded through acquisitions and went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2006.

companies.name: Travelers
companies.description: The Travelers Companies, Inc. is an American multinational insurance company headquartered in New York City and incorporated in Minnesota. It is the second-largest writer of U.S. commercial property and casualty insurance and the sixth-largest personal insurance writer. Travelers has been part of the Dow Jones Industrial Average since 2009.

companies.name: Turkish Airlines
companies.description: Turkish Airlines is the flag carrier airline of Turkey. It operates scheduled services to 358 destinations worldwide, serving more destinations non-stop from a single airport than any other airline. The airline also operates a cargo division and owns a low-cost subsidiary named AJet.

companies.name: Ubs
companies.description: UBS Group AG is a Swiss multinational investment bank and financial services firm headquartered in Zurich and Basel. It is the largest Swiss banking institution and the world's largest private bank, managing the largest amount of private wealth globally. UBS is considered a global systemically important bank with a strong presence in major financial centers worldwide.

companies.name: Ucb
companies.description: UCB is a multinational biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. It focuses on research and development of medications for epilepsy, Parkinson's disease, and Crohn's disease. The company specializes in treatments for severe diseases, particularly in central nervous system disorders, inflammatory disorders, and oncology.

companies.name: Umicore
companies.description: Umicore N.V. is a Belgian multinational materials technology company headquartered in Brussels. Formerly known as Union Minière before 2001, the company operates in the materials technology sector. It is recognized for its global presence in this industry.

companies.name: Unicredit
companies.description: UniCredit S.p.A. is an Italian multinational banking group headquartered in Milan. It is one of the largest banking groups in Italy and ranked as the world's 44th-largest bank by total assets as of 2025. The group operates extensively in the financial sector.

companies.name: Unilever
companies.description: Unilever PLC is a British multinational consumer packaged goods company headquartered in London, England. It was founded in 1930 through the merger of Dutch margarine producer Margarine Unie and British soap maker Lever Brothers. The company operates in the personal care product industry.

companies.name: Unilever Indonesia Tbk
companies.description: Unilever PLC is a British multinational consumer packaged goods company headquartered in London, England. Founded in 1930 from the merger of Margarine Unie and Lever Brothers, it operates globally in the personal care product industry. Unilever Indonesia Tbk is part of this multinational group.

companies.name: Union Pacific
companies.description: The Union Pacific Corporation is an American publicly traded railroad holding company. It serves as the holding company for the Union Pacific Railroad, operating in the transport industry. The company is headquartered in the United States.

companies.name: United Parcel Service
companies.description: United Parcel Service, Inc. (UPS) is an American multinational shipping and supply chain management company founded in 1907. Known for its ground and air shipping services, UPS also operates the UPS Store retail chain. It is one of the world's largest shipping couriers.

companies.name: UnitedHealth
companies.description: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated is an American multinational company based in Eden Prairie, Minnesota. It specializes in health insurance and health care services, selling insurance products under UnitedHealthcare and health care services under the Optum brand. It is the world's fourth-largest company by revenue and the largest health care company by revenue.

companies.name: UOB
companies.description: UOB Kay Hian Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based brokerage firm offering brokerage services, private wealth management, investment management, and financial research. Founded in the early 1900s by Khoo Kay Hian as Kay Hian & Co (Pte), it operates primarily in Singapore.

companies.name: UPM-Kymmene
companies.description: UPM-Kymmene Oyj is a Finnish forest industry company formed by the merger of Kymmene Corporation with Repola Oy and United Paper Mills Ltd in 1996. It operates six business areas including UPM Fibres and UPM Energy, with production plants in 11 countries. UPM is listed on the NASDAQ OMX Helsinki stock exchange and is included in the global Dow Jones Sustainability Index.

companies.name: Vale
companies.description: Vale, formerly Companhia Vale do Rio Doce, is a Brazilian multinational corporation engaged in metals and mining. It is also one of the largest logistics operators in Brazil. The company is based in Brazil and operates globally in the mining sector.

companies.name: VERBUND
companies.description: Verbund AG is Austria's largest electricity provider, generating around 90 percent of its electricity from hydropower and covering about 40 percent of Austria's electricity demand. It operates the supraregional power grid through its subsidiary APG. The Republic of Austria is the largest shareholder with 51%.

companies.name: Vestas Wind Systems
companies.description: Vestas Wind Systems A/S is a Danish company that manufactures, sells, installs, and services wind turbines. Founded in 1945, it operates manufacturing plants in multiple countries including Denmark, Germany, and the United States. The company employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide.

companies.name: VICI Properties
companies.description: Vici Properties Inc. is an American real estate investment trust (REIT) specializing in casino and entertainment properties. Based in New York City, it was formed in 2017 as a spin-off from Caesars Entertainment Corporation during its bankruptcy reorganization. It owns numerous casinos, hotels, racetracks, golf courses, and bowling alleys across the United States and Canada.

companies.name: Vinci
companies.description: Vinci is a French concessions and construction company founded in 1899 as Société Générale d'Entreprises. Its head office is located in Nanterre, near Paris. Vinci is listed on Euronext's Paris stock exchange and is a member of the Euro Stoxx 50 index.

companies.name: Visa
companies.description: Visa Inc. is an American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in San Francisco, California. It facilitates electronic funds transfers worldwide, primarily through Visa-branded credit, debit, and prepaid cards. The company operates globally in the financial services sector.

companies.name: Vodacom
companies.description: Vodacom Group Limited is a South African mobile communications company that provides voice, messaging, data, and converged services. It serves over 130 million customers across Africa. The company is based in South Africa.

companies.name: Vodafone
companies.description: Vodafone Group plc is a British multinational telecommunications company headquartered in Newbury, Berkshire, England. Founded in 1984, it became a global group through mergers including with AirTouch and Mannesmann. In 2013, it sold its 45% stake in Verizon Wireless to Verizon Communications.

companies.name: voestalpine
companies.description: Voestalpine AG is an Austrian steel-based technology and capital goods group headquartered in Linz, Austria. The company operates in steel, automotive, railway systems, profilform, and tool steel industries. As of 2017, it was one of the few profitable steel companies in Europe.

companies.name: Volkswagen
companies.description: Volkswagen Aktiengesellschaft, trading as Volkswagen Group, is a German multinational automotive manufacturing group headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany. It was the world's second-largest automaker by vehicle sales in 2025 and the largest in Europe. The company delivered almost 9 million vehicles worldwide that year.

companies.name: Volvo
companies.description: Volvo Car AB, trading as Volvo Cars, is a Swedish multinational manufacturer of luxury vehicles headquartered in Torslanda, Gothenburg. The company produces SUVs, station wagons, and sedans. Its marketing emphasizes safety and Swedish heritage and design.

companies.name: Walmart
companies.description: Walmart Inc. is an American multinational omnichannel retail corporation headquartered in Bentonville, Arkansas. It operates hypermarkets, discount department stores, grocery stores, pharmacies, and gas stations in the US and 19 other countries. The company was founded in 1962 by Sam and James Walton and owns Sam's Club warehouses.

companies.name: Wärtsilä
companies.description: Wärtsilä Oyj Abp, trading as Wärtsilä Corporation, is a Finnish company manufacturing and servicing power sources and equipment for marine and energy markets. Its products include power plants and ship design capabilities for various vessel types. It also offers services for marine, energy, and oil and gas markets.

companies.name: Waste Connections
companies.description: Waste Connections, Inc. is a North American integrated waste services company headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas. It provides waste collection, transfer, disposal, and recycling services primarily for solid waste. The company operates in the United States and Canada and is the third largest waste management company in North America.

companies.name: WEC Energy
companies.description: WEC Energy Group is an American energy company based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. It provides electricity and natural gas to 4.4 million customers across four states in the United States.

companies.name: WEG
companies.description: WEG S.A. is a Brazilian company headquartered in Jaraguá do Sul, Brazil, operating worldwide in electrical engineering, power, and automation technology. The company was founded in 1961 and serves global markets.

companies.name: Wells Fargo
companies.description: Wells Fargo & Company is an American multinational financial services company operating in 35 countries and serving over 70 million customers worldwide. It is recognized as one of the Big Four banks in the United States and is considered a systemically important financial institution by the Financial Stability Board.

companies.name: Welltower
companies.description: Welltower Inc. is an American real estate investment trust that invests in healthcare facilities including retirement and nursing homes, as well as outpatient medical clinics. The company focuses on healthcare-related real estate investments.

companies.name: Wesfarmers
companies.description: Wesfarmers Limited is an Australian conglomerate headquartered in Perth, Western Australia. It operates mainly in Australia and New Zealand across retail, chemical, fertiliser, industrial, and safety products sectors. It is one of Australia's largest companies by revenue and a major private employer.

companies.name: Westpac
companies.description: Westpac Banking Corporation is an Australian multinational banking and financial services company headquartered at Westpac Place in Sydney. It operates primarily in the banking sector within Australia.

companies.name: Wipro
companies.description: Wipro Limited is an Indian multinational technology company based in Bengaluru. It provides information technology, consulting, and business process services, including cloud computing, computer security, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, and robotics. It is one of India's Big Six IT services companies.

companies.name: Wolters Kluwer
companies.description: Wolters Kluwer N.V. is a Dutch multinational company providing information, software, and services for professionals such as accountants, doctors, and lawyers. It serves markets including legal, business, tax, accounting, finance, audit, risk, compliance, and healthcare.

companies.name: Wuliangye
companies.description: Wuliangye Yibin Co. Ltd. is a baijiu distillery headquartered in Yibin, Sichuan, China. Its proprietary spirit, Wuliangye, is a nongxiang baijiu made from five cereal grains. It is one of the most popular baijiu brands in China and abroad and ranks as the second most valuable spirits brand globally as of 2023.

companies.name: Xcel Energy
companies.description: Xcel Energy Inc. is a U.S. regulated electric utility and natural gas delivery company based in Minneapolis, Minnesota. It serves millions of electricity and natural gas customers across parts of eight states through four operating subsidiaries.

companies.name: Xiaomi
companies.description: Xiaomi is a Chinese multinational technology company headquartered in Beijing, China. It is known for consumer electronics, software, and electric vehicles, and is the third-largest smartphone seller worldwide as of 2025. The company has over 754 million global monthly active users and is the youngest company on the Fortune Global 500.

companies.name: XPeng
companies.description: XPeng Motors, headquartered in Guangzhou, China, is an electric vehicle manufacturer. The company develops AI mobility technologies including advanced driver-assistance systems and in-car intelligent operating systems. It operates offices in the US and Germany and is publicly traded on the NYSE and Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Yara International
companies.description: Yara International ASA is a Norwegian chemical company that produces and sells nitrogen-based mineral fertilizers and related industrial products. Its product range includes phosphate and potash-based fertilizers as well as specialty mineral fertilizers. The company is headquartered in Norway.

companies.name: YPF
companies.description: YPF S.A. is a majority state-owned Argentine energy company engaged in oil and gas exploration, production, transportation, refining, and marketing. It is vertically integrated and ranked among the largest public companies globally. The company is based in Argentina.

companies.name: Zurich Insurance
companies.description: Zurich Insurance Group Ltd. is a Swiss insurance company headquartered in Zürich. It is the largest insurer in Switzerland and ranks among the world's largest public companies. The group has been recognized in global brand rankings.

companies.name: Access Holdings
companies.description: Access Bank Plc is a Nigerian multinational commercial bank owned by Access Bank Group. It is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria, the national banking regulator. The bank operates primarily in Nigeria.

companies.name: African Alliance Insurance
companies.description: African Alliance Insurance Plc is a Nigerian life insurance company founded in 1960 and headquartered in Lagos. It provides life assurance, annuities, and other long-term financial products. The company is listed on the Nigerian Exchange and is one of Nigeria's older indigenous insurance firms.

companies.name: Airtel Africa
companies.description: Airtel Africa plc is a British telecommunications company providing mobile voice, data, and mobile money services across 14 African countries. It is majority owned by Bharti Airtel of India and is listed on the London Stock Exchange. Airtel Nigeria is its most profitable unit.

companies.name: Aradel Holdings
companies.description: Aradel Holdings Plc is a Nigerian integrated energy company operating in upstream, midstream, and downstream oil and gas sectors. It became the largest oil and gas company on the Nigerian Exchange by market capitalization following its listing in October 2024.

companies.name: BUA Cement
companies.description: BUA Cement PLC is a publicly listed Nigerian company that produces and markets cement products. It is the second largest cement producer in Nigeria after Dangote Cement. The company was formed by consolidating the cement interests of the BUA Group, including Obu Cement Company and Kalambaina Company.

companies.name: BUA Foods
companies.description: BUA Foods plc is a Nigerian company based in Lagos and part of the BUA conglomerate. It produces, processes, and distributes food products including sugar, flour, pasta, rice, and edible oils. The company operates divisions specializing in sugar refining, rice milling, and palm oil conversion.

companies.name: Cadbury
companies.description: Cadbury Nigeria Plc is a food, sweets, and drink company headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria, and traded on the Nigerian Stock Exchange. It is a subsidiary of Mondelez International and produces confectionery and cocoa-based products. Its flagship product is Bournvita, and it competes with brands from Nestle and others.

companies.name: C & I Leasing
companies.description: C&I Leasing Group PLC is a Nigerian public maritime company formed in 1990 and listed on the Nigerian Stock Exchange since 1997. It operates through three business units: fleet management, outsourcing, and marine vessel operations.

companies.name: Conoil
companies.description: Conoil Plc is a Nigerian petroleum marketing company involved in selling regulated fuels such as gasoline, kerosene, diesel, and aviation fuel. It also produces and markets lubricants under the Quatro brand. The company was formerly known as National Oil and Chemical Marketing Plc before acquisition by Conpetro in 2002.

companies.name: CWG
companies.description: CWG Plc is a Nigerian pan-African information and communications technology company headquartered in Lagos. Founded in 1992 and listed on the Nigerian Exchange, it provides IT infrastructure, cloud, software, and managed services across West Africa.

companies.name: Daar Communications
companies.description: DAAR Communications plc is an independent privately owned Nigerian broadcasting organization established in 1998 and converted to a public company in 2007. It pioneered Africa Independent Television (AIT) and Raypower FM radio stations. The company is listed on the Nigerian Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Dangote Cement
companies.description: Dangote Cement Plc is a Nigerian multinational cement manufacturer headquartered in Lagos. The company manufactures, imports, packages, and distributes cement and related products in Nigeria and operates plants or import terminals in nine other African countries.

companies.name: Ecobank Transnational Incorporated
companies.description: Ecobank Transnational Inc. (ETI) is a pan-African banking conglomerate with operations in 33 African countries. It is the leading independent regional banking group in West and Central Africa and has subsidiaries in Eastern and Southern Africa, plus affiliates and offices in France, China, Dubai, South Africa, and the UK.

companies.name: Fidelity Bank
companies.description: Fidelity Bank Plc is a commercial bank headquartered in Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria. It is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria as a commercial bank with international authorization.

companies.name: Golden Guinea Breweries
companies.description: Golden Guinea Breweries Plc is a Nigerian brewery located in Umuahia, Abia State. Founded in 1962 by the Eastern Nigerian regional government, it was established as an indigenous competitor to foreign manufacturers and produces Golden Guinea beer.

companies.name: Guinness
companies.description: Guinness Nigeria operates breweries in Nigeria distributing products under the Guinness label. The company is owned by Tolaram.

companies.name: Ikeja Hotel
companies.description: Ikeja Hotel Plc is a Nigerian hospitality company that owns the Sheraton Lagos Hotel and the Federal Palace Hotel & Casino. Through its subsidiary Hans Gremlin Limited, it held a controlling interest in Capital Hotels Plc, owner of the Abuja Continental Hotel. The company operates in the hospitality sector in Nigeria.

companies.name: International Breweries
companies.description: International Breweries plc is a Nigerian brewery that began production in December 1978. Its installed capacity increased from 200,000 hectolitres per annum to 500,000 hectolitres per annum by December 1982. The company operates in the brewing industry in Nigeria.

companies.name: Jaiz Bank
companies.description: Jaiz Bank Plc is a Nigerian bank operating under Islamic banking principles as a non-interest bank. It is the first non-interest bank established in Nigeria and is headquartered in Abuja, the capital city.

companies.name: Julius Berger
companies.description: Julius Berger is a Nigerian construction company headquartered in Abuja, with additional permanent locations in Lagos and Uyo. It operates in the construction industry within Nigeria.

companies.name: John Holt
companies.description: John Holt plc is a Nigerian conglomerate involved in various sectors of the economy. It is a subsidiary of the British company John Holt & Co. (Liverpool) Ltd, with a minority of its shares traded on the Nigerian Stock Exchange.

companies.name: Nigerian Aviation Handling Company
companies.description: Nigerian Aviation Handling Company (NAHCO) is a Nigerian company providing air transportation support services including ground handling, cargo handling, power distribution, and fueling for Nigeria's air transport industry.

companies.name: Nigerian Breweries
companies.description: Nigerian Breweries Plc is the largest brewing company in Nigeria, serving both the Nigerian market and West Africa.

companies.name: Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals
companies.description: NEIMETH International Pharmaceuticals PLC is a publicly listed Nigerian pharmaceutical company founded in 1997 and headquartered in Lagos. It was established to acquire some trading assets of Pfizer International in Nigeria.
