companies.description: NEIMETH International Pharmaceuticals PLC is a publicly listed pharmaceutical company founded in 1997 and headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It was established by a former managing director of Pfizer Products of Nigeria to acquire some of Pfizer International's trading assets in Nigeria.

companies.name: Nestle
companies.description: Nestle Nigeria Plc is a publicly listed food and beverage specialty company headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. Founded in 1961, it manufactures breakfast cereal, baby food products, food seasoning, and hydrolyzed plant protein mix, with its main factory in Ogun State.

companies.name: Nigerian Exchange Group
companies.description: Nigerian Exchange Group, formerly the Nigerian Stock Exchange, is an integrated stock exchange group founded in 1961 and based in Lagos, Nigeria. It has three subsidiaries including the operating exchange, an independent regulation company, and a real estate arm.

companies.description: Red Star Express is a Nigerian logistics company offering local and international deliveries, freight forwarding, warehousing, haulage, document management, and e-commerce order fulfillment services. companies.name: Sterling Financial Holdings Company
companies.description: Sterling Bank Ltd. is a Nigerian commercial bank headquartered in Lagos and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc. The group includes sister subsidiaries The Alternative Bank Limited and SterlingFI Wealth Management Limited.

companies.name: Tantalizers
companies.description: Tantalizers is a Nigerian fast food restaurant chain that opened its first location in Festac Town, Lagos around 1997. It expanded to multiple cities including Lagos, Ibadan, Abuja, and Port Harcourt, serving Nigerian fast food staples such as meat pies, scotch eggs, chicken, and jollof rice.

companies.name: Totalenergies Marketing
companies.description: TotalEnergies SE is a French multinational integrated energy and petroleum company founded in 1924. companies.description: Transcorp Hotel Plc is a Nigerian hospitality company that owns the Transcorp Hilton Abuja. It operates in the hospitality sector in Nigeria. The company is notable for owning the Transcorp Hilton Hotel in Abuja.

companies.description: Transnational Corporation Plc is a Nigerian diversified conglomerate with core interests in hospitality, power, and energy sectors. companies.name: Transcorp Power
companies.description: Transcorp Power Plc is a Nigerian gas-fired thermal power plant located in Ughelli, Delta State. companies.name: United Bank for Africa
companies.description: United Bank for Africa Plc (UBA) is a multinational pan-African financial services group headquartered in Lagos Island, Nigeria. companies.description: Vitafoam Nigeria Plc is a foam manufacturing company based in Lagos, Nigeria. It produces flexible and rigid polyurethane foam products and has interests in Vitafoam Ghana and Vitafoam Sierra Leone. It is one of Nigeria's largest foam manufacturers.

companies.name: Wema Bank
companies.description: Wema Bank Plc is a Nigerian commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria. It operates ALAT By Wema, the largest digital banking system in Nigeria, available in all states and the Federal Capital Territory. The bank celebrated its 80th anniversary in 2025.

companies.name: Zenith Bank
companies.description: Zenith Bank Plc is a multinational financial services institution headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. companies.name: Eaagads
companies.description: Eaagads Limited is a coffee company based in Nairobi, Kenya, with farms in Kiambu county. Incorporated in 1946, it is listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange and trades under the symbol EGAD.

companies.name: Kakuzi
companies.description: Kakuzi PLC is a Kenyan superfood producer listed on the Nairobi and London Stock Exchanges. companies.description: Absa Bank Kenya Plc, formerly Barclays Bank Kenya Limited, is a commercial bank in Kenya and a subsidiary of South Africa-based Absa Group Limited. It is licensed by the Central Bank of Kenya, the national banking regulator.

companies.name: Stanbic Holdings
companies.description: Stanbic Holdings Plc is a Kenyan financial services organization headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya. companies.name: I&m Holdings
companies.description: I&M Holdings Limited is a Kenyan conglomerate headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya. It includes banks, an insurance company, and investment advisory businesses, with subsidiaries in Kenya, Mauritius, Rwanda, Tanzania, and Uganda. The flagship company is I&M Bank Limited, located in Nairobi's central business district.

companies.name: Equity Group Holdings
companies.description: Equity Group Holdings Limited is a financial services holding company based in the African Great Lakes region with headquarters in Nairobi, Kenya. companies.name: Longhorn Publishers

companies.name: Bamburi Cement
companies.description: Bamburi Cement Limited is an industrial company based in Kenya specializing in cement and concrete. companies.name: Kenya Power & Lighting

companies.name: Britam Holdings
companies.description: Britam Holding PLC is a diversified financial services group headquartered in Kenya. It operates in seven African countries including Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, South Sudan, Mozambique, and Malawi. The company is listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange.

companies.name: CIC Insurance Group
companies.description: CIC Insurance Group Limited, or CIC Group, is a Kenyan insurance and investment group operating mainly in Kenya, Uganda, South Sudan, and Malawi. It has a network of branches and subsidiaries across these countries. The group focuses on insurance and investment services.

companies.name: Olympia Capital Holdings
companies.description: Olympia Capital Holdings Limited is a holding company headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, with subsidiaries in Kenya, Botswana, and South Africa. companies.name: Centum Investment

companies.name: Nairobi Securities Exchange
companies.description: The Nairobi Securities Exchange (NSE) is a stock exchange based in Nairobi, Kenya, established in 1954. It began as a voluntary association of stockbrokers and had 66 listed companies as of February 2021. The NSE plays a central role in Kenya's financial markets.

companies.name: Carbacid Investments

companies.name: Mumias Sugar

companies.description: Eveready East Africa PLC is a Kenyan manufacturer and marketer of battery brands. It is headquartered in Nairobi and has a manufacturing plant in Nakuru, Kenya.

companies.name: Safaricom
companies.description: Safaricom PLC is a Kenyan mobile network operator headquartered in Nairobi. It is the largest telecommunications provider in Kenya and offers services including mobile telephony, mobile money transfer, ecommerce, and cloud computing.

companies.name: Access Bank Ghana
companies.description: Access Bank Ghana Plc is a full-service commercial bank in Ghana licensed by the Bank of Ghana. It was formerly known as Access Bank Ghana Limited.

companies.name: Agricultural Development Bank
companies.description: Agricultural Development Bank of Ghana (ADB) is a government-owned development and commercial bank. It provides technical and financial services to agribusiness, farmers, and rural enterprises in Ghana.

companies.name: Aluworks
companies.description: Aluworks is a manufacturing company based in Tema, Greater Accra, Ghana. Founded in 1978 and publicly listed since 1996, it is the only company in Ghana that casts and processes aluminium ingots.

companies.name: Benso Oil Palm Plantation
companies.description: Benso Oil Palm Plantation is a Ghanaian company involved in the production and processing of crude palm oil. Founded in 1978, it owns over 5,000 hectares of oil palm plantations and is a subsidiary of Wilmar International.

companies.name: CalBank
companies.description: CalBank is a commercial bank in Ghana licensed by the Bank of Ghana. It operates as a financial institution within the country.

companies.name: Clydestone (Ghana)
companies.description: Clydestone Ghana PLC is an information and communications technology company based in Accra, Ghana. It provides payment systems, transaction switching, settlement and clearing solutions, and instant card-issuance services. Notably, it offers G-switch, an electronic payment platform, along with cheque-truncation and transaction-processing systems.

companies.name: Camelot Ghana
companies.description: Camelot Ghana is a printing company serving the West African market, founded in 1963. It specializes in printing stationery, security stationery, and business printing such as stock certificates, cheques, and dividend warrants. The company is based in Ghana.

companies.name: Cocoa Processing Company
companies.description: The Cocoa Processing Company Limited is a Ghanaian company focused on cocoa processing. It was formed in 1981 and is listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange's GSE All-Share Index. The company operates within Ghana.

companies.name: Ecobank Ghana
companies.description: Ecobank Ghana PLC is a commercial bank licensed by the Bank of Ghana and based in Ghana. It was recognized as the largest bank in Ghana in the 2023 Ghana Banking Survey by PwC and by LIMA Partners for total assets. The bank operates within the Ghanaian banking sector.

companies.name: Enterprise Group
companies.description: Enterprise Group Plc is a Ghanaian insurance company incorporated on 24 November 2008. It serves as the parent company to its subsidiaries and operates within Ghana. The company is involved in the insurance industry.

companies.name: Fan Milk
companies.description: Fan Milk is a Ghana-based manufacturer and retailer of ice cream and frozen dairy products. In July 2019, Danone acquired full ownership by increasing its stake to 100%. The company operates within Ghana's food manufacturing sector.

companies.name: Guinness Ghana Breweries
companies.description: Guinness Ghana Breweries is a Ghanaian brewery founded in 1960 and located in the Kaase Industrial Area in Kumasi. It is listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange's GSE All-Share Index. Initially, it produced only Guinness Foreign Extra Stout.

companies.name: Produce Buying Company
companies.description: Produce Buying Company is a Ghanaian cocoa bean company formed on November 13, 1981. It is listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange's GSE All-Share Index. The company operates in the agricultural sector focusing on cocoa beans in Ghana.

companies.name: Standard Chartered Bank Ghana
companies.description: Standard Chartered Ghana is a banking and financial services company in Ghana and an 80% subsidiary of Standard Chartered. Operating since 1896, it is one of the oldest companies in Ghana and is listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange's GSE All-Share Index.

companies.name: SIC Insurance Company
companies.description: SIC Insurance PLC is a Ghanaian insurance company formed in February 1962. It is listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange's GSE All-Share Index and operates in the insurance sector in Ghana.

companies.name: Societe Generale Ghana
companies.description: Societe Generale Ghana Limited is a bank based in Accra, Ghana, and part of the Société Générale banking group. It is listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange and is a component of the GSE All-Share Index, operating 45 networked branches in Ghana.

companies.name: TotalEnergies Ghana
companies.description: TotalEnergies Marketing Ghana PLC, formerly Mobil Oil Ghana Limited, is a Ghanaian petroleum company. It operates 225 petrol stations across Ghana and is listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange's GSE All-Share Index.

companies.name: First Atlantic Bank
companies.description: First Atlantic Bank is a universal bank in Ghana licensed as a commercial bank by the Bank of Ghana. It operates under the national banking regulations and provides financial services in Ghana.

companies.name: Kasapreko
companies.description: Kasapreko Company Limited is a Ghanaian manufacturer and producer of alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, certified ISO 22000:2005. Its flagship product is Alomo Bitters, a herbal-based alcoholic drink, and it has received recognition in Ghana's beverage sector.
